generic.Defined scope/population: All submissions with insured locations in a monitored CRESTA or postcode accumulation zone
generic.In-scope period: Accumulation run dated on or after submission receipt and before terms are released
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Aggregation run reference, run date, zone code and modelled PML captured on the authority screen
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-bind zone aggregate agrees to the accumulation report total for the same zone and date
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Accumulation report output attached to the submission with run timestamp and model version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Zone capacity breaches raised as referrals with referral number and decision recorded
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period with exposure in a monitored accumulation zone
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where post-bind zone aggregate exceeds the authority schedule limit with no referral
generic.Exception handling path: Underwriter refers the zone breach to the Senior Underwriter who accepts or declines the capacity use
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run attached and modelled PML inside the zone limit, or a recorded referral decision
generic.Evidence location: Accumulation report and run reference on the submission in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Map insured locations to accumulation zones in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the location schedule on the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Assign each location its CRESTA or postcode accumulation zone from the exposure reference data.
Resolve any location the geocoder cannot place before running the accumulation.
Done when every insured location carries an accumulation zone code.
verify: Filter the location schedule for blank or unresolved zone codes.
Pass when no insured location is left without an accumulation zone code.

steps.title: Run the zone accumulation report in Power BI
sop: Run the accumulation report in Power BI for each zone the account touches.
Select the current treaty year and the peril set relevant to the occupancy.
Note the run reference number and run date produced by the report.
Done when a report exists for every zone the account exposes.
verify: Check the run date is on or after the submission receipt date.
Pass when a dated accumulation run exists for each exposed zone.

steps.title: Test modelled aggregate PML against the zone limit on the authority schedule
sop: Add the modelled PML for this risk to the existing zone aggregate from the report.
Compare the resulting figure against the per-zone limit on the authority schedule.
Record the headroom or the overshoot in the authority assessment note.
Done when the post-bind position is stated for every exposed zone.
verify: Recompute the post-bind aggregate for the largest zone by hand.
Pass when the recorded post-bind aggregate matches the report plus this risk.

steps.title: Check the insured and named subsidiaries for in-force policies in the policy administration system
sop: Search the policy administration system for the insured and each named subsidiary.
List in-force policies that already contribute exposure in the same zone.
Adjust the aggregate so shared exposure is counted once and not double counted.
Done when existing in-force exposure for the group is identified and treated.
verify: Re-run the search on the parent name to confirm no subsidiary was missed.
Pass when every in-force group policy in the zone is reflected in the aggregate.

steps.title: Flag the submission for referral where zone capacity consumption breaches the threshold
sop: Compare the capacity this risk consumes against the stated percentage threshold.
Set the referral flag on the submission where the threshold is breached.
Name the zone and the consumption percentage in the referral reason.
Done when a referral exists for every breaching zone.
verify: List breaching zones and check each has a referral raised.
Pass when no breaching zone is left without a referral.

steps.title: Record the aggregation run reference on the authority assessment screen
sop: Enter the run reference number and run date on the authority assessment screen.
Attach the accumulation report output to the submission record.
Note the model version used so the run can be reproduced.
Done when reference, date and output are all on the submission.
verify: Reopen the submission and confirm the attachment opens and matches the reference.
Pass when the attached report reference equals the recorded run reference.

steps.title: Obtain Senior Underwriter acceptance of the capacity position
sop: Review the accumulation output and the post-bind zone position on the referral.
Accept or decline the capacity use against the zone limit and portfolio plan.
Record the decision and reasoning on the referral record.
Done when the capacity decision is recorded against the submission.
verify: Check the decision is recorded before any terms are released to the broker.
Pass when no terms were released ahead of the recorded capacity decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with emerging risk classes or non-filed manuscript coverage structures
generic.In-scope period: Assessed at submission triage and before any indication is released to the broker
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Novelty reason, risk class, form type and CUO sign-off flag captured on the submission
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of novel-risk flagged submissions agrees to the CUO sign-off queue for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Appetite statement version and wording library reference recorded with the determination
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Prohibited or no-write hits logged with the decline or exception outcome recorded
generic.Test population: All submissions flagged as novel or manuscript in the underwriting workstation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a quote was released on a novel-risk submission before CUO sign-off
generic.Exception handling path: Senior Underwriter escalates contested novelty calls to the Chief Underwriting Officer for ruling
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CUO sign-off flag set with a stated novelty attribute on every novel-risk submission
generic.Evidence location: Referral notes on the submission in the underwriting workstation and the GRC platform

steps.title: Compare the coverage structure against the product wording library
sop: Open the proposed wording and compare it to the filed base form in the wording library.
Identify every clause that is manuscript rather than filed.
Classify the build as filed form, filed form with endorsements, or manuscript.
Done when the form type is recorded on the submission.
verify: Check the recorded form type against the marked-up wording.
Pass when the form type matches the clauses actually deviating from the filed form.

steps.title: Test the risk class against the novel and emerging risk list in the appetite statement
sop: Open the current appetite statement in the GRC platform and locate the emerging risk list.
Compare the risk class and exposure to entries such as cyber war, PFAS or crypto custody.
Record which listed category the risk matches, or record no match.
Done when the emerging risk test result is recorded with the appetite version.
verify: Confirm the appetite statement version used is the current published version.
Pass when the test cites the current appetite version and a stated outcome.

steps.title: Screen the risk against the prohibited and no-write list in the GRC platform
sop: Screen the insured, its parent and the industry class against the no-write list.
Where a hit occurs, stop the novelty assessment and record the prohibited outcome.
Where no hit occurs, record that CUO sign-off is the only remaining barrier.
Done when the prohibited-risk screen result is on the submission.
verify: Check the screening result is dated within the current submission cycle.
Pass when a dated no-write screen result is present for the insured.

steps.title: Set the CUO sign-off flag and state the novelty attribute
sop: Set the CUO sign-off flag on the submission in the underwriting workstation.
State which attribute makes the risk novel, such as untested peril or manuscript trigger.
Route the submission to the Chief Underwriting Officer queue.
Done when the flag is set with a stated novelty attribute.
verify: Confirm the novelty reason field is populated and specific to the risk.
Pass when no flagged submission carries a blank or generic novelty reason.

steps.title: Obtain the Chief Underwriting Officer determination
sop: Review the form analysis, appetite test and prohibited screen on the submission.
Decide whether the risk may proceed, proceed with conditions, or must be declined.
Record the determination and reasoning in the referral notes.
Done when a determination is recorded against the submission.
verify: Check the determination is recorded before any indication is issued.
Pass when no indication predates the recorded CUO determination.

steps.title: Record the sign-off determination in the policy administration system
sop: Transcribe the CUO determination and any conditions onto the submission record.
Update the policy administration system so downstream quoting reads the sign-off state.
Attach the appetite and wording references relied on to the record.
Done when the determination and conditions are visible on the submission.
verify: Reopen the submission and confirm the sign-off state blocks quoting where required.
Pass when quoting is blocked on any submission without a recorded sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every new business and renewal submission assigned to a named underwriter for terms
generic.In-scope period: Authority letter current at the assessment date and covering the policy inception date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authority letter reference, premium ceiling, limit ceiling and complexity tier recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of in-authority decisions agrees to submissions without a raised referral
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authority letter version and assessment stamped with user and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Out-of-authority outcomes logged with the required next authority level named
generic.Test population: All submissions assessed for authority in the period by line of business
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the assessing underwriter has no current authority letter for the line
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-authority submissions route to the Senior Underwriter or the named higher authority
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: In-authority or out-of-authority outcome stamped with user, timestamp and reason
generic.Evidence location: Authority assessment screen on the submission and the authority record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Open the underwriter authority record in the GRC platform
sop: Open the authority record for the assigned underwriter in the GRC platform.
Confirm the letter is in force at the assessment date and not expired.
Confirm the letter covers the line of business on the submission.
Done when a current in-scope authority letter is identified.
verify: Check the letter expiry date against the assessment date.
Pass when the letter is unexpired and names the submission line of business.

steps.title: Test estimated annual premium against the premium ceiling
sop: Read the estimated annual premium from the submission header.
Compare it against the premium ceiling stated on the authority letter.
Record the tested premium figure and the ceiling applied.
Done when the premium test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the premium comparison against the letter ceiling.
Pass when the recorded result matches the premium and ceiling on file.

steps.title: Test requested limit and attachment against the limit ceiling
sop: Read the requested policy limit and attachment point from the submission.
Compare both against the limit ceiling and any attachment restriction on the letter.
Record the tested limit values and the ceiling applied.
Done when the limit test result is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded limit values match the submission terms requested.
Pass when tested limit and attachment equal the requested terms.

steps.title: Assess risk complexity tier against the letter scope
sop: Determine the hazard grade and whether the risk is multi-state or multi-year.
Compare the complexity tier against the scope stated on the authority letter.
Record any complexity attribute that falls outside the letter.
Done when the complexity assessment is recorded on the submission.
verify: Check each complexity attribute tested is named in the record.
Pass when hazard grade, territory spread and term are all evidenced as tested.

steps.title: Stamp the in-authority or out-of-authority outcome in the underwriting workstation
sop: Select the in-authority or out-of-authority outcome on the authority assessment screen.
Where out of authority, name the required next authority level.
Confirm the outcome stamps user and timestamp automatically.
Done when the outcome is stamped on the submission.
verify: Reopen the submission and check user and timestamp are present on the outcome.
Pass when every assessed submission carries a stamped outcome.

steps.title: Route out-of-authority submissions to the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review out-of-authority submissions routed from the authority assessment.
Confirm the named next authority level is correct for the breaching dimension.
Accept the routing or redirect to the correct authority holder.
Done when the submission sits with the correct authority holder.
verify: Check the receiving authority level against the breaching dimension.
Pass when no submission is routed to an authority level below the breach requires.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks intended to be written on treaty capacity without a facultative placement
generic.In-scope period: Treaty slip in force at the policy inception date being assessed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty name, section, automatic limit and special acceptance conditions recorded on the risk
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum insured tested equals the sum insured on the submission terms
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Treaty slip version and assessment note stored against the risk with a date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaty condition failures logged with the facultative or referral outcome recorded
generic.Test population: All risks bound on treaty capacity in the period without a facultative record
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a bound risk exceeds the treaty automatic limit with no facultative record
generic.Exception handling path: Underwriter refers treaty breaches to the Senior Underwriter for special acceptance or facultative
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Treaty name, section and limit relied on recorded before terms are offered
generic.Evidence location: Authority assessment note on the risk in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Open the treaty slip in force at inception in the underwriting workstation
sop: Identify the policy inception date from the submission terms.
Open the treaty slip in force for that date and the relevant class section.
Confirm the class of business on the submission is covered by the section.
Done when the governing treaty section is identified.
verify: Check the treaty year of the slip covers the inception date.
Pass when the slip period spans the policy inception date.

steps.title: Test the risk against treaty exclusions
sop: Read the exclusions in the treaty section for occupancy, territory and peril.
Test the risk occupancy, location territory and covered perils against each exclusion.
Record any exclusion the risk touches.
Done when the exclusion test result is recorded on the risk.
verify: Check each exclusion category was tested and the result stated.
Pass when occupancy, territory and peril tests are all evidenced.

steps.title: Compare sum insured against the treaty automatic acceptance limit
sop: Read the sum insured and policy limit from the submission terms.
Compare against the automatic acceptance limit for the section.
Record whether facultative support is required for any excess.
Done when the automatic acceptance test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the excess over the automatic limit where one exists.
Pass when the recorded excess equals sum insured minus the automatic limit.

steps.title: Check treaty special acceptance conditions are satisfied
sop: List the special acceptance conditions on the section such as survey or minimum rate.
Test each condition against the risk file and the proposed terms.
Record any condition not satisfied and the action needed to satisfy it.
Done when every special acceptance condition has a tested result.
verify: Check each listed condition carries a satisfied or not-satisfied result.
Pass when no special acceptance condition is left untested.

steps.title: Record treaty name, section and limit on the authority assessment note
sop: Write the treaty name, section and automatic limit relied on into the assessment note.
State the sum insured tested and the resulting reliance position.
Save the note against the risk in the policy administration system.
Done when the treaty reliance is recorded against the risk.
verify: Reopen the risk and confirm the treaty reference is readable before bind.
Pass when the treaty reference is present on the risk ahead of the bind date.

steps.title: Refer treaty condition failures to the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review risks where an exclusion, limit or special acceptance test failed.
Decide between special acceptance, facultative placement or declining the risk.
Record the decision and the route chosen against the risk.
Done when every failed condition carries a recorded decision.
verify: List risks with a failed condition and check each has a decision.
Pass when no risk proceeds to bind with an unresolved treaty condition failure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions tested against the documented referral trigger list before terms are issued
generic.In-scope period: Triggers evaluated on the submission as it stands at the authority assessment date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Triggers fired, routing target and referral queue recorded on the referral header
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of referrals raised agrees to the count of submissions with a fired trigger
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Trigger list version and routing decision stored with the referral header and date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Manual routing overrides logged with the reason and the approving authority
generic.Test population: All referrals raised in the period across new business and renewals
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a referral is routed below the authority level the fired trigger requires
generic.Exception handling path: Routing disputes escalate to the Senior Underwriter who sets the correct target queue
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: At least one documented trigger recorded on every referral raised
generic.Evidence location: Referral header in the underwriting workstation and the trigger list in the GRC platform

steps.title: Evaluate the submission against the referral trigger list in the GRC platform
sop: Open the current referral trigger list published in the GRC platform.
Test the submission against each trigger in turn and tick those that fire.
Note the trigger list version used for the evaluation.
Done when every trigger has been evaluated and the fired set is recorded.
verify: Check the trigger list version is the current published version.
Pass when the evaluation cites the current trigger list version.

steps.title: Route specialty triggers to the named specialty desk
sop: Identify any specialty trigger such as environmental, professional lines or cyber.
Select the named specialty desk queue rather than the line manager queue.
Record why the specialty route was chosen on the referral header.
Done when specialty triggers are routed to their named desk.
verify: Check each specialty trigger maps to its named desk on the referral.
Pass when no specialty trigger is routed to a generic line queue.

steps.title: Route premium and limit breaches to the next authority level
sop: Identify triggers that fired only on premium or limit thresholds.
Select the authority level immediately above the assigned underwriter.
Record the breaching value and the required authority level.
Done when threshold breaches are routed to the next authority level.
verify: Compare the routing level against the breaching threshold size.
Pass when the routing level meets or exceeds the level the breach requires.

steps.title: Confirm the named authority holder is available in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the selected referral queue in the underwriting workstation.
Confirm the named authority holder is not marked out of office.
Where unavailable, select the deputy named on the authority schedule.
Done when the referral targets an available authority holder.
verify: Check the target holder availability status at the routing time.
Pass when the referral is not sitting with an out-of-office holder.

steps.title: Record fired triggers and routing target on the referral header
sop: Enter every fired trigger on the referral header in the policy administration system.
Enter the chosen routing target and the reason it was selected.
Save the header so the workflow can route the referral.
Done when triggers and target are both recorded on the header.
verify: Reopen the referral and confirm at least one trigger is recorded.
Pass when no referral exists with an empty fired trigger list.

steps.title: Confirm routing correctness with the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review the fired triggers and the routing target on newly raised referrals.
Redirect any referral routed below the level its trigger requires.
Record the routing confirmation or the correction made.
Done when the routing has been confirmed or corrected.
verify: Sample referrals raised in the period and re-test the routing level.
Pass when every sampled referral sits at or above the required authority level.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every submission that has completed authority assessment and is moving to pricing
generic.In-scope period: Note written after the authority outcome and before the pricing stage is entered
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authority level applied, schedule version, tested values and thresholds present in the note
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium and limit values in the note agree to the submission record values
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Note stored in the underwriting file with author, timestamp and schedule version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals raised cross-referenced by referral number inside the same note
generic.Test population: All submissions entering the pricing stage in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a submission reaches pricing with no authority rationale note present
generic.Exception handling path: Missing notes are returned by the Senior Underwriter for completion before pricing resumes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Note states authority level, schedule version, tested values and referral position
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting file on the submission and the document record in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Draft the authority determination note in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the authority assessment screen and start the determination note.
State the authority level applied and the schedule version used.
Name the assessing underwriter and the assessment date.
Done when the note header states level and schedule version.
verify: Check the schedule version cited is the current published version.
Pass when the note cites a current, unsuperseded schedule version.

steps.title: Record tested values and thresholds in the note
sop: Write the premium, limit and complexity values that were tested.
Write the threshold each value was tested against from the schedule.
State the outcome of each individual test.
Done when every tested value has a stated threshold and outcome.
verify: Compare the note values against the submission record values.
Pass when premium and limit in the note equal the submission record.

steps.title: Cross-reference any raised referral by number
sop: Identify any referral raised from this authority assessment.
Enter the referral number and the trigger that caused it in the note.
Link the referral record to the note so the chain is traceable.
Done when every raised referral is cross-referenced in the note.
verify: Open each cited referral number and confirm it matches the submission.
Pass when every cited referral resolves to this submission.

steps.title: State the triggers evaluated where no referral was raised
sop: List the triggers that were evaluated and did not fire.
State explicitly that no referral was required and why.
Avoid leaving the no-referral position implied rather than stated.
Done when the no-referral position is explicitly written.
verify: Check the note names the triggers evaluated rather than a blanket statement.
Pass when evaluated triggers are named individually in the note.

steps.title: Save the note to the underwriting file in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Save the completed note to the underwriting file for the account.
Confirm the note is indexed to the submission and visible to pricing.
Confirm author and timestamp are captured on the stored document.
Done when the note is stored and visible on the account.
verify: Retrieve the note from the account file as a pricing user would.
Pass when the note opens with author and timestamp shown.

steps.title: Confirm the note is present before pricing begins
sop: Check submissions queued for pricing carry an authority rationale note.
Return any submission without a note to the underwriter before pricing.
Record the completeness check against the submission.
Done when every submission entering pricing has a note.
verify: Sample submissions at the pricing stage and check for the note.
Pass when no sampled submission entered pricing without a note.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions requiring the authority schedule for their line of business and product code
generic.In-scope period: Schedule version current and published at the date of the authority assessment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Line of business, product code, schedule name and version reference recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Product code on the schedule cited matches the product code on the submission header
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Schedule name and version date recorded on the authority assessment screen
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Product overlays and pilot caps logged with their effect on the applied authority
generic.Test population: All authority assessments completed in the period across products
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an assessment cites a superseded authority schedule version
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or unpublished schedules escalate to the Senior Underwriter before terms proceed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current schedule identified for the product with a recorded name and version date
generic.Evidence location: Authority library in Microsoft 365 SharePoint and the assessment screen in the workstation

steps.title: Read line of business and product code from the submission header
sop: Open the submission header in the underwriting workstation.
Read the line of business and the product code recorded on it.
Confirm the product code matches the coverage actually being offered.
Done when line of business and product code are confirmed.
verify: Compare the product code against the coverage requested in the submission.
Pass when the product code matches the coverage being offered.

steps.title: Open the current authority schedule from the published library
sop: Open the authority library in Microsoft 365 SharePoint.
Locate the authority schedule for the identified product code.
Open the version marked as current and published.
Done when the product authority schedule is open.
verify: Check the schedule opened is the published version and not a draft.
Pass when the schedule carries published status.

steps.title: Confirm the schedule version has not been superseded
sop: Read the version date and status on the schedule front page.
Compare it against the library version history for the product.
Confirm no later version has been published since.
Done when the schedule is confirmed as the latest published version.
verify: Re-check the library version history at the assessment date.
Pass when no later published version exists for the product.

steps.title: Identify product-specific overlays on the schedule
sop: Read any overlay attached to the schedule such as a new-product restriction.
Read any pilot programme cap that reduces the standard authority.
Record each overlay and the limit it imposes.
Done when all applicable overlays are recorded.
verify: Check each overlay attached to the schedule is reflected in the record.
Pass when no attached overlay is omitted from the assessment.

steps.title: Record schedule name and version on the authority assessment screen
sop: Enter the schedule name and version reference on the assessment screen.
Enter any overlay applied alongside the schedule reference.
Save the record so downstream authority tests read the same schedule.
Done when name, version and overlays are recorded on the submission.
verify: Reopen the submission and check the recorded version against the library.
Pass when the recorded version equals the current published version.

steps.title: Confirm schedule selection with the Senior Underwriter for new or pilot products
sop: Review schedule selections on new, pilot or recently amended products.
Confirm the correct schedule and overlay set was applied.
Record confirmation or correct the schedule reference.
Done when the schedule selection is confirmed for in-scope products.
verify: Sample assessments on pilot products and re-check the schedule cited.
Pass when every sampled pilot assessment cites the correct schedule and cap.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions being placed on the underwriter authority grid before routing is decided
generic.In-scope period: Grid evaluation performed on the terms as proposed at the assessment date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, total insured value, limit, attachment and term entered into the grid
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Grid input values agree to the corresponding values on the submission record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Resulting authority tier saved against the submission with grid version and date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Grid modifiers applied logged with the tier movement each modifier caused
generic.Test population: All submissions with an authority tier derived from the grid in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the recorded tier is lower than the highest triggering grid dimension
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicting dimension outcomes resolve to the most restrictive tier, not an average
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authority tier populated on the submission and traceable to a named grid dimension
generic.Evidence location: Authority grid result stored on the submission in Guidewire PolicyCenter

steps.title: Enter risk attributes into the authority grid in the underwriting workstation
sop: Enter estimated annual premium and total insured value into the grid.
Enter requested limit, attachment point and policy term.
Confirm each entered value matches the submission record.
Done when all grid input fields are populated.
verify: Compare each grid input against the submission record value.
Pass when every grid input equals the submission record value.

steps.title: Test each grid dimension separately and record its tier
sop: Run the grid dimension by dimension rather than as a single blended result.
Record the tier each dimension places the risk into.
Identify the dimension producing the highest tier.
Done when every dimension has a recorded tier outcome.
verify: Check each grid dimension carries an individual tier result.
Pass when no dimension is left without a recorded tier.

steps.title: Apply the most restrictive tier where dimensions disagree
sop: Compare the tiers produced across the dimensions.
Select the most restrictive tier rather than averaging the outcomes.
Record which dimension drove the selected tier.
Done when the governing tier and its driving dimension are recorded.
verify: Compare the selected tier against the highest dimension tier.
Pass when the selected tier equals the highest dimension tier.

steps.title: Apply grid modifiers for loss history and non-standard features
sop: Check for adverse loss-ratio history on the account.
Check whether the insured is new to the company or the term is non-standard.
Apply each applicable modifier and record the tier movement it causes.
Done when all applicable modifiers are applied and recorded.
verify: Check each applied modifier names the tier movement it caused.
Pass when every applied modifier has a stated tier effect.

steps.title: Save the authority tier against the submission in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Save the resulting authority tier onto the submission record.
Confirm downstream routing reads the saved tier automatically.
Attach the grid working so the result can be reproduced.
Done when the tier is saved and readable by routing.
verify: Reopen the submission and confirm the tier field is populated.
Pass when no assessed submission has a blank authority tier.

steps.title: Review contested tier placements with the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review placements where modifiers or conflicting dimensions were involved.
Confirm the most restrictive outcome was applied.
Record agreement or reset the tier with a stated reason.
Done when contested placements carry a recorded review.
verify: Re-run the grid on a sample of contested placements.
Pass when the reviewed tier matches the highest triggering dimension.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every quote, bind and endorsement transaction raised on the underwriting portfolio
generic.In-scope period: The monthly authority-usage reporting period in which the transaction was raised
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authority level, approver name and referral number populated on each transaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Transaction count in the authority extract agrees to the transaction count in the policy system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authority level stamped on each transaction with user and transaction timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blank or defaulted authority levels logged and corrected before the extract is issued
generic.Test population: All quote, bind and endorsement transactions in the monthly extract
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any transaction in the extract carries a blank or defaulted authority level
generic.Exception handling path: UW Operations Manager returns incomplete transactions to the underwriter for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authority level populated and matching the grid tier on every transaction
generic.Evidence location: Transaction records in the policy administration system and the extract in the GRC platform

steps.title: Populate the authority level on each quote transaction
sop: Open the quote transaction in the policy administration system.
Enter the authority level derived from the authority grid for the risk.
Save the transaction so the level is stamped with user and time.
Done when the quote transaction carries an authority level.
verify: Reopen the quote and check the authority field is populated.
Pass when no quote transaction has a blank authority level.

steps.title: Populate the authority level on the bind transaction
sop: Open the bind transaction and enter the authority level applied at bind.
Confirm the level reflects any referral approval used rather than the quoted level.
Save the transaction and confirm the stamp is applied.
Done when the bind transaction carries the applied authority level.
verify: Compare the bind authority level against the referral approval used.
Pass when the bind level reflects the approval actually relied on.

steps.title: Record approver name and referral number where an approval was used
sop: Identify transactions where a referral approval supported the authority used.
Enter the approver name and the referral number on the transaction.
Link the referral record so the approval can be retrieved.
Done when approver and referral number are recorded.
verify: Open each cited referral and confirm the approver name matches.
Pass when every cited approver matches the referral decision record.

steps.title: Reconcile the recorded level against the authority grid tier
sop: Compare the recorded authority level against the grid tier for the risk.
Investigate any transaction where the two differ.
Correct the recorded level or record why the grid tier was superseded.
Done when every transaction level agrees to the grid or carries a reason.
verify: Sample transactions and re-derive the tier from the grid.
Pass when the recorded level equals the derived tier or has a stated reason.

steps.title: Re-record the authority level on premium or limit changing endorsements
sop: Identify mid-term endorsements that change premium or limit.
Re-derive the authority level for the endorsed position.
Enter the re-derived level rather than inheriting the original level.
Done when each qualifying endorsement carries its own authority level.
verify: Compare endorsement authority levels against the original policy level.
Pass when no premium or limit changing endorsement simply inherits the original level.

steps.title: Verify transactions appear in the monthly authority-usage extract
sop: Run the monthly authority-usage extract from the GRC platform.
Reconcile the extract transaction count to the policy system count.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every referral raised requiring supporting evidence before release to the authority holder

steps.title: Attach loss runs to the referral in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Obtain loss runs covering the number of years the referral standard requires.
Check the valuation date is within 90 days of the referral date.
Attach the loss runs to the referral record.
Done when in-date loss runs for the full period are attached.
verify: Read the valuation date on each attached loss run.

steps.title: Attach the survey or inspection report and open recommendations

steps.title: Attach the pricing model output to the referral

steps.title: Attach the proposed wording marked against the filed base form
sop: Obtain the proposed policy wording or manuscript endorsement.
Mark the deviations against the filed base form so changes are visible.
Attach the marked wording to the referral record.
Done when the marked-up wording is attached.
verify: Check the marked wording identifies each deviation from the base form.
Pass when every manuscript clause is marked against the filed form.

steps.title: Complete the referral attachment checklist in the policy administration system
sop: Open the referral attachment checklist on the referral record.
Tick each attachment supplied against its checklist item.
Record a reason against any item deliberately omitted.
Done when every checklist item is ticked or has an omission reason.
verify: Scan the checklist for unticked items without a reason.
Pass when no mandatory item is unticked and unexplained.

steps.title: Confirm attachment completeness with the Senior Underwriter before release
sop: Review the attachment set and the stated omissions on the referral.
Accept the omission reasons or require the missing evidence.
Record the completeness confirmation on the referral.
Done when the referral is confirmed complete for release.
verify: Sample released referrals and check for missing mandatory attachments.
Pass when no released referral lacks a mandatory attachment or reason.

generic.Exception handling path: Terms outside the approved position require a fresh referral to the Senior Underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Outcome, approver and timestamp recorded on every closed referral
generic.Evidence location: Referral decision record in the policy administration system and OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Record the referral outcome from the system picklist
sop: Open the returned referral in the policy administration system.
Select approved, approved with conditions, modified or declined from the picklist.
Avoid free-text outcome descriptions that reporting cannot read.
Done when a picklist outcome is recorded on the referral.
verify: Check the outcome field holds a controlled picklist value.
Pass when no closed referral carries a free-text outcome.

steps.title: Transcribe each condition into a separate condition line
sop: Read the decision text and identify every distinct condition imposed.
Enter each condition as its own line so it can be cleared individually.
Avoid combining several conditions into one line.
Done when each condition exists as a discrete line.
verify: Count the condition lines against the conditions in the decision text.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Record modifications as changes from the referred terms
sop: Compare the approved terms against the terms as referred.
Record each change to limit, deductible, rate or wording explicitly.
State the referred value and the approved value for each change.
Done when every modification is recorded as a before and after pair.
verify: Check each modification names both the referred and approved value.
Pass when no modification is recorded without both values.

steps.title: Capture approver name, authority level and decision timestamp
sop: Record the approver name and the authority level relied on.
Record the decision timestamp as returned by the workflow.
Attach the decision document to the referral record.
Done when approver, level and timestamp are all recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded approver against the workflow decision entry.
Pass when the recorded approver matches the workflow record.

steps.title: Update the submission terms to the approved position
sop: Amend the submission terms in the underwriting workstation to the approved position.
Confirm no term is left at the referred value where it was modified.
Confirm pre-bind conditions are visible on the submission.
Done when submission terms equal the approved position.
verify: Compare submission terms against the approved decision line by line.
Pass when no submission term is more favourable than the approved position.

steps.title: Confirm the recorded decision with the Senior Underwriter before quoting
sop: Review the recorded outcome and conditions against the decision issued.
Confirm the submission terms reflect the approval accurately.
Release the submission for quoting or return it for correction.
Done when the recorded decision is confirmed as accurate.
verify: Sample quotes issued after referral and compare to the approved terms.
Pass when no sampled quote exceeds the approved position.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every referral requiring an underwriter recommendation before routing to an authority holder
generic.In-scope period: Recommendation written on the terms proposed at the date the referral is raised
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recommendation, deviation list, guideline references and premium effects populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium effect of the listed deviations reconciles to the gap against technical price
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation stored on the referral with author, date and guideline version cited
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each deviation logged with its justification and the compensating control relied on
generic.Test population: All referrals routed to an authority holder in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a listed deviation carries no written justification
generic.Exception handling path: Senior Underwriter returns referrals with unjustified deviations before they are routed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Explicit write, write with conditions or decline recommendation recorded on the referral
generic.Evidence location: Referral document in OpenText Document Mgmt linked to the underwriting workstation record

steps.title: State the recommendation at the top of the referral
sop: Open the referral document in the underwriting workstation.
State write, write with conditions or decline as the opening line.
Avoid leaving the recommendation implied by the narrative.
Done when an explicit recommendation heads the referral.
verify: Read the opening of the referral for an explicit recommendation.
Pass when one of the three recommendation values is stated.

steps.title: List each guideline deviation with its guideline reference
sop: Compare the proposed terms against the underwriting guideline clause by clause.
List each deviation as its own line with the guideline clause reference.
Avoid grouping unrelated deviations into a single line.
Done when every deviation is listed with a clause reference.
verify: Check each listed deviation cites a resolvable guideline clause.
Pass when every deviation line carries a valid clause reference.

steps.title: Give the justification and compensating control for each deviation
sop: Write the commercial or technical justification against each deviation.
Name the compensating control or risk feature relied on.
Avoid justifications that only restate the deviation.
Done when every deviation has a justification and a named control.
verify: Check each deviation line has both a justification and a control.
Pass when no deviation is left without a written justification.

steps.title: Quantify the premium effect of each deviation
sop: Take the technical price from the pricing model output.
Quantify the premium effect of each deviation against technical price.
Show the aggregate effect against the proposed premium.
Done when each deviation carries a quantified premium effect.
verify: Sum the individual premium effects and compare to the technical gap.
Pass when the summed effects reconcile to the technical price gap.

steps.title: Reconcile the recommendation to the attached pricing output
sop: Read the attached pricing output alongside the written recommendation.
Confirm the recommendation does not contradict the pricing conclusion.
Amend either the narrative or the pricing basis where they conflict.
Done when recommendation and pricing output are consistent.
verify: Compare the recommended price to the price on the pricing output.
Pass when the recommended price equals the pricing output price.

steps.title: Store the recommendation on the referral in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Save the completed recommendation to the referral record.
Confirm author and date are captured on the stored document.
Confirm the document is visible to the authority holder queue.
Done when the recommendation is stored against the referral.
verify: Retrieve the recommendation as an authority holder would.
Pass when the document opens with author and date shown.

steps.title: Review the recommendation quality before routing
sop: Review the recommendation, deviations and justifications before routing.
Return referrals where a deviation lacks justification or quantification.
Record the review outcome on the referral.
Done when the referral is cleared for routing or returned.
verify: Sample routed referrals and check deviation justifications are present.
Pass when every sampled deviation carries a justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open referrals that have passed their recorded response deadline

steps.title: Open the referral ageing view in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the referral ageing view filtered to referrals past their deadline.

Note the broker quote deadline against each overdue referral.
Done when the overdue list for the day is identified.
verify: Check the ageing view uses the recorded response deadline field.
Pass when the overdue list is driven by the recorded deadline.

steps.title: Issue the first chase through the referral workflow
sop: Issue the chase to the named authority holder through the workflow.

Confirm the chase appears in the referral history.
Done when the first chase is logged against the referral.
verify: Open the referral history and confirm the chase entry exists.
Pass when every overdue referral shows a logged first chase.

steps.title: Restate the broker deadline and commercial consequence in the chase
sop: State the broker quote deadline in the chase message.
State the commercial consequence of further delay on the account.
Name the decision still outstanding so the holder can act quickly.
Done when the chase carries deadline and consequence.
verify: Read the chase text for the broker deadline and consequence.
Pass when both appear in the logged chase message.

steps.title: Record verbal or interim responses on the referral
sop: Record any verbal or interim response from the authority holder.
Note the date, time and substance of the response.
Update the referral status so ageing reflects real progress.
Done when responses received are recorded on the referral.
verify: Compare the referral status against the last recorded response.
Pass when the status reflects the latest recorded response.

steps.title: Escalate to the authority holder manager after the second chase window
sop: Identify referrals unanswered after the second chase window closes.
Escalate to the authority holder manager through the workflow.
State the days overdue and the broker deadline at risk.
Done when the escalation is logged on the referral.
verify: Check every referral past the escalation window has an escalation entry.
Pass when no referral exceeds the window without an escalation.

steps.title: Report persistent overdue referrals in the operations review
sop: Extract overdue referral counts by authority holder for the period.
Share the extract in the underwriting operations review.
Record agreed actions against named holders.
Done when overdue performance is reported with actions.
verify: Check reported counts reconcile to the ageing view for the period.
Pass when the reported counts agree to the ageing view.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals where the approval requirement must be classified before routing

steps.title: Classify the ask against the controlled approval type list
sop: Open the approval type list on the referral header.
Classify the ask as rate deviation, limit deviation, wording deviation or appetite exception.
Select the type from the controlled list rather than free text.
Done when a controlled approval type is selected.
verify: Check the approval type field holds a controlled list value.
Pass when no referral carries a free-text approval type.

steps.title: Split multiple approvals into separate requests
sop: Identify every distinct approval the referral requires.
Raise each approval separately with its own authority level.
Avoid blending several asks into one combined request.
Done when each approval sits as its own request.
verify: Count approval requests against the distinct authority levels needed.
Pass when the counts agree with no bundled request.

steps.title: State the exact numeric ask for each approval
sop: State the rate percentage, limit amount or deductible level being requested.
Avoid qualitative wording such as a modest reduction.
Record the current guideline value alongside the requested value.
Done when each approval carries an exact numeric ask.
verify: Check each approval request holds a numeric requested value.
Pass when no approval request is stated only qualitatively.

steps.title: Map each approval type to a documented authority in the schedule
sop: Open the authority schedule and locate the authority covering each ask.
Record the authority level that must approve each request.
Escalate any ask with no mapped authority before proceeding.
Done when every approval maps to a documented authority.
verify: Check each approval cites an authority level from the schedule.
Pass when no approval request lacks a mapped authority level.

steps.title: Record the approval requirement set on the referral header
sop: Enter the full approval requirement set on the referral header.
Confirm the workflow routes to every required authority holder.
Save the header so routing reads the requirement set.
Done when the requirement set drives the routing.
verify: Check the routing targets match the recorded authority levels.
Pass when every required holder appears in the routing.

steps.title: Confirm the requirement classification with the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review the classified approval types and numeric asks on the referral.
Correct any misclassification or missing authority mapping.
Record the confirmation on the referral header.
Done when the requirement set is confirmed.
verify: Sample referrals and re-test the classification against the schedule.
Pass when every sampled classification maps to the correct authority.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals requiring a memorandum summarising risk, exposure and proposed terms

steps.title: Complete the risk profile section of the memorandum
sop: Open the standard referral memorandum template in the underwriting workstation.
Enter insured name, occupancy, locations, values and years of loss experience.
Confirm each value is taken from the submission record.
Done when the risk profile section is complete.
verify: Compare profile values against the submission record.
Pass when every profile value matches the submission record.

steps.title: Summarise the exposure analysis in the memorandum
sop: State the largest single loss estimate for the risk.
State the aggregate position for the zone after writing the risk.
Reference the accumulation run used for the aggregate figure.
Done when the exposure analysis section is complete.

Pass when the memo aggregate equals the accumulation run output.

sop: Enter limit, attachment, deductible, rate and premium as proposed.
State the key wording positions including any manuscript clause.
Confirm the terms match the submission record.
Done when the proposed terms section is complete.
verify: Compare memo terms against the system-held proposed terms.
Pass when limit and premium in the memo equal the system values.

sop: Enter incurred and paid loss figures for the experience period.
Calculate the burning cost from the incurred figures and exposure.
State the valuation date of the loss figures used.
Done when loss history and burning cost are stated.
verify: Recalculate burning cost from the stated incurred figures.
Pass when the recalculated burning cost matches the memo.

steps.title: Cross-check every memo figure against the pricing output
sop: Read the pricing model output alongside the completed memo.
Check each figure in the memo against the pricing output and submission.

sop: Save the memo to the referral record using the standard template name.
Confirm the version date and author are captured.
Confirm the memo is visible in the authority holder queue.
Done when the memo is stored and visible.
verify: Retrieve the memo from the referral record.
Pass when the stored memo shows template name and version date.

steps.title: Review memorandum completeness before routing
sop: Review the memo sections for completeness and internal consistency.
Return memoranda where figures do not reconcile to the submission.
Record the review outcome on the referral.
Done when the memo is cleared or returned.
verify: Sample routed memoranda and re-test premium and limit against the system.
Pass when no sampled memo differs from the system-held terms.

steps.title: Query bound comparables in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Query bound accounts by class code, revenue band and territory.
Restrict the query to the last three underwriting years.
Record the filter values used for the query.
Done when a comparable candidate set is returned.

Pass when the re-run returns the same record count.

Retain only accounts where rate is measured on the same basis.
Record the structural filter applied.

sop: Extract rate per unit of exposure for each comparable account.
Extract the loss ratio and the retention outcome for each account.
Load the extract into Power BI for distribution analysis.
Done when the three measures are extracted for every comparable.

Pass when all three measures are populated for every comparable.

sop: Calculate the median and quartiles of the comparable rate distribution.
Plot the referred account rate against the distribution in Power BI.
State whether the account sits below, at or above the median.
Done when the referred account position is stated.
verify: Recompute the median from the comparable extract.
Pass when the stated position matches the recomputed median.

steps.title: Attach the comparable set and filters to the referral
sop: Attach the comparable extract to the referral in the underwriting workstation.
Record the query filters used so the reviewer can reproduce the set.
Record the extract date alongside the attachment.
Done when the extract and its filters are attached.
verify: Check the attachment includes the stated filter criteria.
Pass when the filters recorded reproduce the attached set.

steps.title: Record a no-comparables note where the class is too thin
sop: Where fewer comparables exist than the benchmark standard requires, note it.
State the class and the number of comparables available.
Record the alternative pricing evidence used instead.
Done when the no-comparables position is documented.
verify: Check referrals without benchmarks carry a no-comparables note.
Pass when every benchmark-free pricing referral has a stated reason.

steps.title: Return the referral through the workflow rather than by email

Return it to the originating underwriter through the workflow route.

Done when the return is issued through the workflow.

State the point in the process where each must be cleared.

State the changes in terms that would trigger a re-referral.

verify: Check the validity date is present and later than the decision date.

sop: Open the returned referral and read the implementation instructions.

verify: Check the referral history for an acknowledgement entry.

Close the referral in the workflow.

sop: Release the referral into the selected queue through the workflow.
