sop: Open the submission and read the broker quote-by date.
Record the quote-by date on the referral header.
Where no date is stated, obtain one from the broker before proceeding.
Done when the broker quote-by date is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded date against the broker submission.
Pass when the recorded quote-by date matches the broker request.

steps.title: Compare against the internal referral SLA for the approval type
sop: Look up the internal SLA turnaround for the approval type.
Calculate the SLA-implied response date from the referral creation date.
Take the earlier of the SLA date and the broker-implied date.
Done when the governing date is identified.
verify: Recompute both candidate dates and compare to the chosen date.
Pass when the chosen date is the earlier of the two.

steps.title: Set the response deadline with date and time
sop: Enter the deadline date and time on the referral header.
Leave turnaround time between the deadline and the quote release.
Save the header so the deadline is fixed at creation.
Done when the deadline holds both a date and a time.
verify: Check the deadline field holds a time as well as a date.
Pass when no referral carries a date-only deadline.

steps.title: Flag the referral as expedited where the window is short
sop: Compare the resulting window against the standard SLA window.
Set the expedited flag where the window is shorter.
State the reason the window is compressed.
Done when short-window referrals are flagged expedited.
verify: Check expedited flags against the calculated windows.
Pass when every sub-SLA window carries the expedited flag.

steps.title: Confirm the deadline drives the ageing and chase views
sop: Open the ageing view and locate the newly created referral.
Confirm the recorded deadline drives its ageing position.
Correct the header if the referral does not appear correctly.
Done when the referral ages against the recorded deadline.
verify: Check the ageing view uses the recorded deadline field.
Pass when the referral ages from the recorded deadline.

steps.title: Review unachievable deadlines with the UW Operations Manager
sop: Review referrals where the window is materially shorter than the SLA.
Decide whether to expedite, reprioritise or renegotiate the broker date.
Record the decision against the referral.
Done when unachievable deadlines carry a recorded decision.
verify: List referrals with sub-SLA windows and check for a decision.
Pass when every sub-SLA referral carries a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open referrals in the underwriter portfolio awaiting a decision
generic.In-scope period: The status review cadence applied to open referrals in the period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral status, last update date, interim responses and at-risk flag populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open referral count in the tracking view agrees to the count in the policy system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each status change stored with the user and the update timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: At-risk referrals logged with the escalation raised and the broker notification made
generic.Test population: All open referrals in the period across the underwriter portfolio
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an open referral status is untouched beyond the review cadence period
generic.Exception handling path: At-risk referrals escalate to the UW Operations Manager and the broker is notified
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every open referral carrying a status updated within the review cadence
generic.Evidence location: Outstanding referral view in the underwriting workstation and the Power BI tracking report

steps.title: Open the outstanding referral view for the portfolio
sop: Open the outstanding referral view in the underwriting workstation.
Filter to referrals in the underwriter own portfolio.
Sort by days open so stale referrals surface first.
Done when the open referral list is on screen.
verify: Compare the list count to the policy system open referral count.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Update the status of each open referral
sop: Set each referral to pending, with-authority, awaiting-information or decided.
Avoid leaving a referral at its creation status once it has moved.
Save the status so the update timestamp is captured.
Done when every open referral carries a current status.
verify: Check the last update date on each open referral.
Pass when no open referral is untouched beyond the cadence period.

steps.title: Record interim and verbal responses on the referral
sop: Record any verbal or interim response received from the authority holder.
Note the substance and the expected next step.
Update the status so ageing reflects actual progress.
Done when interim responses are recorded against referrals.
verify: Compare status against the last recorded response on a sample.
Pass when statuses match the latest recorded responses.

steps.title: Flag referrals at risk of missing the broker deadline
sop: Compare each referral deadline against the days remaining.
Set the at-risk flag where the deadline will likely be missed.
Raise the escalation through the workflow for flagged referrals.
Done when at-risk referrals are flagged and escalated.
verify: Check flagged referrals have an escalation entry.
Pass when every at-risk referral carries an escalation.

steps.title: Notify the broker where a referral will miss the promised date
sop: Identify referrals that will not be decided by the promised date.
Notify the broker with a revised expected date.
Record the notification on the submission record.
Done when affected brokers have been notified.
verify: Check missed-date referrals carry a broker notification entry.
Pass when every missed promise has a recorded notification.

steps.title: Review portfolio referral status coverage
sop: Run the Power BI referral tracking report for the portfolio.
Identify referrals with stale statuses beyond the cadence.
Assign follow-up to the owning underwriter and record it.
Done when stale referrals have an assigned follow-up.
verify: Re-run the report after follow-up and check stale counts.
Pass when no referral remains stale beyond the cadence after follow-up.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referred risks assessed against the portfolio position for their class and territory
generic.In-scope period: Portfolio position as at the current reporting month against the plan year
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class, territory, portfolio position, appetite status and alignment conclusion recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Class written premium in the assessment agrees to the Power BI portfolio report
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Portfolio extract attached with report date and appetite statement version cited
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks in reduce-status classes logged with the alignment justification recorded
generic.Test population: All referrals decided in the period in classes with a stated appetite status
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a referral in a reduce-status class carries no alignment assessment
generic.Exception handling path: Contested alignment calls escalate to the Chief Underwriting Officer for ruling
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Portfolio and accumulation position evidenced on the referral before decision
generic.Evidence location: Portfolio extract in Power BI attached to the referral in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Pull the current portfolio position for the class and territory
sop: Open the portfolio report in Power BI for the class and territory.
Read written premium, loss ratio and exposure against plan.
Note the report date so the assessment is traceable.
Done when the current portfolio position is captured.
verify: Compare the captured figures to the Power BI report.
Pass when captured written premium equals the report figure.

steps.title: Assess the effect of writing the risk on accumulation and class mix
sop: Add the risk exposure to the class and zone accumulation position.
Compare the resulting class mix against the plan mix.
State the movement the risk causes in both measures.
Done when the effect on accumulation and mix is stated.
verify: Recompute the post-risk accumulation from the extract.
Pass when the stated movement matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Check the class appetite status in the appetite statement
sop: Open the current appetite statement in the underwriting workstation.
Read whether the class is in growth, hold or reduce status.
Record the appetite version and the class status.
Done when the appetite status is recorded with its version.
verify: Confirm the appetite version cited is the current published version.
Pass when the assessment cites the current appetite version.

steps.title: State whether the risk supports the portfolio direction
sop: Compare the risk against the stated portfolio direction for the class.
State whether it supports or works against that direction and why.
Reference the accumulation and mix effects in the reasoning.
Done when a reasoned alignment statement exists.
verify: Check the statement references specific portfolio measures.
Pass when the alignment statement cites measured effects.

steps.title: Record the alignment conclusion on the referral
sop: Enter the alignment conclusion on the referral in the workstation.
Attach the portfolio extract used for the assessment.
Confirm the conclusion is visible ahead of the decision entry.
Done when the conclusion and extract are on the referral.
verify: Check the conclusion timestamp precedes the decision timestamp.
Pass when the alignment conclusion predates the decision.

steps.title: Obtain Chief Underwriting Officer view on reduce-status classes
sop: Review referrals in classes carrying reduce status.
Confirm or challenge the alignment conclusion recorded.
Record the portfolio ruling on the referral.
Done when reduce-status referrals carry a recorded ruling.
verify: List reduce-status referrals decided in the period.
Pass when each carries a recorded alignment assessment and ruling.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals reaching an approve, modify or decline decision by an authority holder
generic.In-scope period: Decision recorded inside the response deadline window set on the referral
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome, rationale, changed terms, decline reason code and decision timestamp recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Decisions recorded equal referrals closed in the workflow for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision stored with approver identity, authority level and decision timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Decisions taken outside authority logged and escalated for ratification or reversal
generic.Test population: All referral decisions recorded in the period by authority level
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a decision is recorded by a user whose authority is below the referral tier
generic.Exception handling path: Referrals above the holder authority escalate to the Chief Underwriting Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision with written rationale recorded by an authorised holder inside the deadline
generic.Evidence location: Referral decision record in the underwriting workstation and the policy administration system

steps.title: Confirm the decision sits inside the holder own authority
sop: Read the referral tier and the approval type on the referral header.
Compare it against the holder own authority letter.
Escalate rather than decide where the tier exceeds the letter.
Done when authority to decide is confirmed or escalated.
verify: Compare the deciding user authority against the referral tier.
Pass when the deciding authority meets or exceeds the tier.

steps.title: Select approve, modify or decline on the referral
sop: Open the referral in the underwriting workstation.
Select the outcome from the controlled decision list.
Save the outcome so the decision timestamp is captured.
Done when a controlled outcome is recorded.
verify: Check the outcome field holds a controlled list value.
Pass when no decision is recorded as free text.

steps.title: Write the rationale referencing risk features and pricing evidence
sop: Write the rationale naming the risk features that drove the outcome.
Reference the pricing evidence relied on from the referral pack.
Avoid rationales that only restate the outcome.
Done when a reasoned rationale is recorded.
verify: Read the rationale for named risk or pricing evidence.
Pass when the rationale cites specific evidence from the pack.

steps.title: State each changed term explicitly where modifying
sop: List each term being changed with its referred and approved value.
Cover limit, deductible, rate and wording changes individually.
Avoid referring back to prior discussion instead of stating values.
Done when every modified term has explicit values.
verify: Check each modified term carries a numeric or textual approved value.
Pass when no modified term is left undefined.

steps.title: Record the decline reason code where declining
sop: Select the decline reason code from the controlled reason list.
Confirm the code reflects the primary reason and not a secondary one.
Save so the code feeds appetite and decline reporting.
Done when declines carry a controlled reason code.
verify: Check the decline extract for entries with blank reason codes.
Pass when every decline carries a controlled reason code.

steps.title: Confirm the decision is recorded inside the response deadline
sop: Compare the decision timestamp to the recorded response deadline.
Record the reason where the decision falls outside the deadline.
Confirm the ageing clock is stopped by the decision entry.
Done when the timing position is recorded.
verify: Compare decision timestamps against deadlines for the period.
Pass when late decisions carry a recorded reason.

steps.title: Review decisions taken near or above authority limits
sop: Sample decisions recorded close to the holder authority ceiling.
Confirm the deciding authority covered the referral tier.
Record ratification or require the decision to be reversed.
Done when sampled decisions are confirmed within authority.
verify: Re-test the deciding user authority against the referral tier.
Pass when no sampled decision was taken below the required authority.

generic.Defined scope/population: Load-bearing assumptions stated in the underwriting narrative on the referral
generic.In-scope period: Assumptions as stated in the narrative version current at the review date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assumption, challenge, evidence tested and underwriter response recorded for each item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of challenges raised equals the count of recorded underwriter responses
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Challenge entries stored on the referral with author, date and narrative version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assumptions accepted as-is logged so the completeness of the challenge is evidenced
generic.Test population: All referrals reviewed with a written underwriting narrative in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an approved referral carries an unanswered challenge
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved assumption disputes are escalated to pricing review with the Pricing Actuary
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written challenge entries against named assumptions with underwriter responses
generic.Evidence location: Challenge log on the referral in the underwriting workstation and OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Identify the load-bearing assumptions in the narrative
sop: Read the underwriting narrative on the referral.
Identify assumptions on exposure growth, loss trend, rate adequacy and risk improvement.
List each assumption separately in the challenge log.
Done when the load-bearing assumptions are listed.
verify: Check each listed assumption is quoted from the narrative.
Pass when every listed assumption traces to the narrative text.

steps.title: Test each assumption against loss history and survey findings
sop: Compare each assumption against the loss history on the account.
Compare against the survey findings and outstanding recommendations.
Record the evidence used for each test.
Done when every assumption has been tested against evidence.
verify: Check each assumption test cites source evidence.
Pass when no assumption is tested without named evidence.

steps.title: Benchmark assumptions against the portfolio with the Pricing Actuary
sop: Compare the loss trend and rate adequacy assumptions to portfolio benchmarks.
Quantify the difference between the assumption and the benchmark.
Record the benchmark source and period used.
Done when benchmark comparisons are recorded.
verify: Recompute the benchmark difference from the source data.
Pass when the recorded difference matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Record a written challenge against each rejected assumption
sop: Write a challenge entry against each assumption not accepted.
State the reason and the evidence contradicting the assumption.
Save each challenge as its own trackable entry.
Done when every rejected assumption has a challenge entry.
verify: Count challenge entries against rejected assumptions.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Require a written underwriter response with evidence
sop: Return the challenge log to the underwriter for response.
Require supporting evidence or an amended assumption for each challenge.
Record the response against the challenge entry it answers.
Done when every challenge carries a response.
verify: Check each challenge entry has a linked response.
Pass when no challenge remains unanswered.

steps.title: Record assumptions accepted as stated
sop: List the assumptions accepted without challenge.
State briefly why each was accepted.
Save the acceptance record alongside the challenges.
Done when accepted assumptions are recorded.
verify: Check accepted plus challenged assumptions cover the listed set.
Pass when every identified assumption has a challenge or acceptance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Decided referrals requiring communication back to the referring underwriter
generic.In-scope period: Communication issued inside the response deadline recorded on the referral
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision, conditions, non-approved terms, contact point and communication timestamp
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Conditions communicated equal the condition lines on the decision record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Communication logged on the referral with date, time and full message content
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Communications issued after the deadline logged with the reason for the delay
generic.Test population: All referral decisions communicated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where an approved referral communication omits an attached condition
generic.Exception handling path: Queries on conditions route back to the Senior Underwriter before the quote is released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision communication logged with timestamp inside the response deadline
generic.Evidence location: Referral communication log in the underwriting workstation and policy administration system

steps.title: Send the decision through the referral workflow
sop: Open the decided referral in the underwriting workstation.
Send the decision to the referring underwriter through the workflow.
Confirm the send occurs inside the response deadline.
Done when the decision is sent through the workflow.
verify: Compare the send timestamp against the response deadline.
Pass when the communication timestamp is inside the deadline.

steps.title: Restate every condition attached to the approval
sop: Copy each condition line from the decision into the communication.
Confirm the count matches the conditions recorded on the decision.
Avoid summarising conditions into a shortened list.
Done when every condition appears in the communication.
verify: Count conditions in the communication against the decision record.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: State which proposed terms were not approved
sop: List the proposed terms that were rejected or reduced.
State clearly that these must not be quoted to the broker.
Give the approved value in place of each rejected term.
Done when non-approved terms are stated explicitly.
verify: Check each rejected term carries its approved replacement value.
Pass when no rejected term is left without a replacement value.

steps.title: Give the contact point for condition queries
sop: Name the contact for queries on the conditions.
State that queries must be resolved before the quote is released.
Record the contact on the communication entry.
Done when a named contact is included.
verify: Check the communication names a contact for queries.
Pass when every approval communication names a query contact.

steps.title: Log the communication against the referral record
sop: Log the communication with date and time on the referral.
Attach the full message content to the record.
Confirm it is visible to the referring underwriter.
Done when the communication is logged with content.
verify: Retrieve the logged communication from the referral.
Pass when the logged entry shows date, time and content.

steps.title: Confirm receipt with the referring underwriter
sop: Open the communicated decision and read the conditions.
Raise any query with the named contact before quoting.
Confirm receipt through the workflow.
Done when receipt is confirmed on the referral.
verify: Check the referral shows a receipt confirmation entry.
Pass when the decision was acknowledged before quoting.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals requiring an independent review of risk analysis, pricing and terms
generic.In-scope period: Review performed on the pricing model version current at the referral date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rating inputs, technical price, proposed price and review conclusion recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rating inputs used in the model agree to the submission record values
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review conclusion stored separately from the narrative with reviewer name and date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rating input differences logged with the explanation and correction applied
generic.Test population: All referrals with an independent review recorded in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a rating input differs from the submission record with no explanation
generic.Exception handling path: Pricing disagreements escalate to the Pricing Actuary for a technical ruling
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Independent conclusion recorded by a reviewer other than the originating underwriter
generic.Evidence location: Independent review note on the referral in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Re-read the pricing model output and check rating inputs
sop: Open the pricing model output attached to the referral.
Compare each rating input against the submission record.
Record any input that does not tie back to source.
Done when every rating input has been checked.
verify: Sample rating inputs and trace each to the submission record.
Pass when every sampled input matches the submission record.

steps.title: Quantify the gap between technical price and proposed price
sop: Read the technical price and the proposed price from the output.
Calculate the shortfall or margin in premium and percentage terms.
Record the quantified gap on the review note.
Done when the price gap is quantified and recorded.
verify: Recalculate the gap from the technical and proposed prices.
Pass when the recorded gap matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Form an independent view before reading the recommendation
sop: Review the risk analysis and underlying evidence first.
Form and record a view on the risk before reading the recommendation.
Note where the independent view differs from the recommendation.
Done when an independent view is recorded.
verify: Check the review note records a view separate from the narrative.
Pass when the independent view is recorded as its own entry.

steps.title: Obtain a technical pricing view from the Pricing Actuary
sop: Review the rating basis and model parameters used for the risk.
Confirm the technical price is soundly derived for the exposure.
Record the technical view and any parameter concern.
Done when the technical pricing view is recorded.
verify: Check the technical view names the parameters tested.
Pass when the pricing view cites the parameters reviewed.

steps.title: Test whether the proposed terms deliver the assumed protection
sop: Read the proposed terms and conditions alongside the risk analysis.
Test whether each protection the analysis assumes is actually secured.
Record any gap between assumed and drafted protection.
Done when the terms have been tested against the analysis.
verify: Check each assumed protection maps to a drafted term.
Pass when no assumed protection is missing from the terms.

steps.title: Record the independent review conclusion on the referral
sop: Write the independent review conclusion as a separate record.
Include the price gap, input findings and terms findings.
Store it in OpenText Document Mgmt against the referral.
Done when the conclusion is stored separately from the narrative.
verify: Check the reviewer name differs from the originating underwriter.
Pass when the reviewer is not the originating underwriter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referred risks requiring form filing, rate basis and treaty compliance confirmation
generic.In-scope period: Filing and treaty positions as at the intended policy inception date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: States of exposure, form filing status, rate basis, treaty position and placement route
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States confirmed as filed equal the states of exposure on the location schedule
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filing evidence and treaty reference recorded with the sources and check date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filing or treaty exceptions logged with the resolution route recorded
generic.Test population: All referrals with a compliance confirmation recorded in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a referral is approved with an unresolved form-filing or treaty exception
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved filing or treaty issues escalate to the Chief Underwriting Officer before approval
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filed-and-approved status evidenced for the form in every state of exposure
generic.Evidence location: Compliance confirmation on the referral in the GRC platform and the policy system

steps.title: Confirm form and endorsement filing in every state of exposure
sop: List the states of exposure from the location schedule.
Check the filing status of the form and each endorsement per state.
Record the filed-and-approved status against each state.
Done when every state of exposure has a filing status.
verify: Compare states checked against states on the location schedule.
Pass when every state of exposure carries a filing status.

steps.title: Confirm the rate basis is filed or a permitted deviation
sop: Identify the rate basis used for the proposed pricing.
Check it against the filed rates for the product and state.
Where deviating, confirm the deviation is permitted under the authority matrix.
Done when the rate basis position is recorded.
verify: Check each deviation cites the permitting authority provision.
Pass when every rate deviation cites a permitting provision.

steps.title: Verify treaty compliance for exclusions, territory and special acceptances
sop: Open the treaty section governing the risk in the policy system.
Test exclusions, territorial scope and special acceptance conditions.
Record the treaty position and any condition not met.
Done when treaty compliance is recorded with the section cited.
verify: Check the recorded treaty section covers the risk class.
Pass when the cited section covers the class and inception date.

steps.title: Check surplus lines and non-admitted implications
sop: Determine whether any exposure must be placed non-admitted.
Confirm the placement route is permitted for each state involved.
Record any surplus lines filing obligation created.
Done when the placement route is confirmed for all states.
verify: Check each non-admitted state has a permitted route recorded.
Pass when no non-admitted exposure lacks a permitted route.

steps.title: Record the compliance confirmation and sources on the referral
sop: Record the compliance confirmation in the GRC platform against the referral.
List the sources checked including filing records and treaty slip.
Note the check date so currency is evidenced.
Done when the confirmation and sources are recorded.
verify: Check the confirmation names the sources actually consulted.
Pass when every confirmation cites its sources and check date.

steps.title: Escalate unresolved filing or treaty exceptions
sop: Review referrals carrying an unresolved filing or treaty exception.
Decide whether to resolve, restructure or decline the risk.
Record the ruling on the referral before approval proceeds.
Done when every exception carries a recorded ruling.
verify: List approved referrals and check for open compliance exceptions.
Pass when no referral is approved with an open exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals with identified information gaps preventing a decision
generic.In-scope period: Request window running from the request date to the due date set on each item
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Request text, required output, due date and closure status recorded per item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of requests raised equals the count of closure entries at decision time
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each request stored on the referral with raise date, due date and returned evidence
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests unmet at the due date logged with the revised date or the decision to proceed
generic.Test population: All referrals placed in awaiting-information status in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a referral is decided with an open unclosed information request
generic.Exception handling path: Requests that cannot be met escalate to the Senior Underwriter to decide or decline
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each information request logged with a due date and a recorded closure status
generic.Evidence location: Information request log on the referral in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List each information gap as a discrete request
sop: Identify the gaps preventing a decision on the referral.
Raise each gap as its own request rather than one general ask.
Name the document or analysis required for each.
Done when every gap exists as a discrete request.
verify: Check each request names a specific deliverable.
Pass when no request is a general call for more detail.

steps.title: State what the additional analysis must demonstrate
sop: State the question each piece of analysis must answer.
State the threshold or evidence that would close the gap.
Record this against the request so it can be tested on return.
Done when every request states its acceptance condition.
verify: Check each request carries a testable acceptance condition.
Pass when no request lacks a stated acceptance condition.

steps.title: Set a due date for each request aligned with the broker deadline
sop: Read the broker deadline recorded on the referral.
Set a due date for each request that leaves decision time.
Record the due dates on the request log.
Done when every request carries a due date.
verify: Compare request due dates against the broker deadline.
Pass when no due date falls after the broker deadline.

steps.title: Place the referral in awaiting-information status
sop: Set the referral status to awaiting-information in the policy system.
Confirm the ageing clock reflects the paused position.
Notify the originating underwriter of the status change.
Done when the referral shows awaiting-information status.
verify: Check the ageing view reflects the paused status.
Pass when the referral ages as paused while requests are open.

steps.title: Return the requested analysis against each request
sop: Prepare or obtain the analysis for each open request.
Attach the response to the specific request it answers.
Note where a request cannot be met and why.
Done when every request has a response or a stated blocker.
verify: Check each request has a linked response attachment.
Pass when no request is left without a response or blocker.

steps.title: Confirm each returned item closes its gap before deciding
sop: Test each returned item against the acceptance condition set.
Close the request where the condition is met.
Re-issue or escalate where the condition is not met.
Done when every request is closed or escalated.
verify: List decided referrals and check for open requests.
Pass when no decided referral carries an open request.

generic.Defined scope/population: Complete referral packs for closed referrals requiring retention
generic.In-scope period: Retention class and disposition date drawn from the underwriting records schedule
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, referral number, retention class and disposition date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed pack count agrees to the count of closed referrals for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed pack held read-only with versioning applied on any subsequent change
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Incomplete packs logged with the missing item and the completion action recorded
generic.Test population: All referral packs filed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a filed pack is missing its decision document or condition lines
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete packs return to the UW Operations Manager for completion before sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete pack filed with retention class and disposition date applied and indexed
generic.Evidence location: Referral pack in OpenText Document Mgmt indexed from the GRC platform record

steps.title: Assemble the complete referral pack for filing
sop: Collect the memo, attachments, decision, conditions and communications.
Assemble them as a single referral pack record.
Check no component is left on a personal or team drive.
Done when the full pack exists as one record.
verify: Check each expected component is present in the pack.
Pass when memo, decision, conditions and communications are all present.

steps.title: Apply the retention class and disposition date
sop: Look up the retention class for underwriting referral records.
Apply the class and calculate the disposition date from closure.
Record both on the filed pack in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Done when retention class and disposition date are applied.
verify: Recompute the disposition date from the closure date and class.
Pass when the applied date matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Index the pack for retrieval
sop: Index the pack by policy number, insured name and referral number.
Confirm each index value matches the policy administration system.
Save the index so search returns the pack on any of the three.
Done when the pack is retrievable on all three index values.
verify: Search on each index value and confirm the pack returns.
Pass when all three searches return the filed pack.

steps.title: Confirm the filed record is non-editable and versioned
sop: Check the pack is stored read-only after filing.
Confirm any subsequent change creates a new version rather than overwriting.
Record the versioning configuration check.
Done when the immutability check is recorded.
verify: Attempt an edit on a filed pack in a controlled test.
Pass when the edit creates a new version rather than overwriting.

steps.title: Spot-check retrieval and attachment integrity
sop: Select a sample of filed packs for the period.
Retrieve each pack and open every attachment.
Record any attachment that fails to open.
Done when the sample retrieval check is recorded.
verify: Check every sampled attachment opened successfully.
Pass when no sampled attachment failed to open.

steps.title: Audit filed packs for completeness
sop: Sample filed referral packs against the closed referral list.
Test each sampled pack for its decision document and conditions.
Return incomplete packs for completion and record the finding.
Done when the completeness audit is recorded for the period.
verify: Reconcile filed pack count to closed referral count.
Pass when every closed referral has a complete filed pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approvals requiring conditions before or after bind on the referred risk
generic.In-scope period: Clearance windows running from approval to bind, 30 days or renewal as set
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Condition text, clearance owner, deadline, pre-bind flag and required evidence
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Condition lines on the policy record equal condition lines on the approval decision
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Conditions stored on the decision with owner, deadline and evidence requirement

steps.title: Enter each approval condition as its own condition line

Enter each condition as a separate trackable condition line.
Name the clearance owner against each line.

steps.title: Set a clearance deadline for each condition

Enter the resulting clearance deadline date on the line.
Confirm the deadline drives the condition tracking view.
Done when every condition line carries a deadline.
verify: Check each condition line holds a clearance deadline.
Pass when no condition line is left without a deadline.

steps.title: Mark pre-bind conditions so binding is blocked
sop: Set the pre-bind flag on conditions that must clear before bind.
Confirm the system blocks binding while the flag is open.
Test the block on the submission before releasing terms.
Done when pre-bind conditions block binding.
verify: Attempt a bind with an open pre-bind condition in a test.
Pass when the system prevents the bind.

steps.title: State the evidence required to clear each condition
sop: State the evidence needed such as survey confirmation or signed warranty.
Record the evidence requirement on each condition line.
Avoid conditions that cannot be objectively cleared.
Done when every condition names its clearance evidence.
verify: Check each condition line names specific clearance evidence.
Pass when no condition line lacks an evidence requirement.

steps.title: Confirm conditions carry through to the policy record
sop: Open the policy record and confirm the conditions are present.
Confirm the servicing team can see the conditions and owners.
Correct any condition that did not carry across.
Done when all conditions are visible on the policy record.
verify: Compare policy record conditions to the decision conditions.
Pass when the two sets match line for line.

steps.title: Rule on requests to waive pre-bind conditions
sop: Review any request to waive or defer a pre-bind condition.
Decide whether to waive, replace or maintain the condition.
Record the ruling and rationale against the condition line.
Done when every waiver request carries a ruling.
verify: List bound policies and check for uncleared pre-bind conditions.
Pass when no policy was bound with an uncleared pre-bind condition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks where a gross line is being written and a net retained line must be derived

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the net retained line exceeds the class net retention limit
generic.Exception handling path: Excess net lines refer to the Senior Underwriter for facultative or line reduction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Gross line, ceded layers and net retained line all recorded for the risk
generic.Evidence location: Retention calculation working attached to the risk in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Enter gross line and policy limit into the retention calculation
sop: Open the retention calculation on the risk in the underwriting workstation.
Enter the gross line requested and the full policy limit.
Confirm both values match the proposed terms.
Done when gross line and limit are entered.
verify: Compare entered values against the proposed terms.
Pass when the entered gross line equals the proposed line.

steps.title: Apply the treaty retention and layers in order
sop: Apply the company retention first from the treaty structure.
Apply each surplus or excess layer in its correct order.
Derive the net retained line from the remaining exposure.
Done when the net retained line is derived.
verify: Re-derive the net line by reapplying the layers in order.
Pass when the re-derived net line matches the recorded net line.

steps.title: Test the net retained line against the class retention limit
sop: Look up the company net retention limit for the class.
Compare the derived net line against that limit.
Record the headroom or the excess amount.
Done when the retention test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the comparison against the class retention limit.
Pass when the recorded outcome matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Show the ceded percentage to each layer
sop: Calculate the percentage ceded to each treaty layer.
Record the percentage and amount against each layer.
Confirm the percentages sum to the total ceded amount.
Done when each layer carries a ceded percentage and amount.
verify: Sum the layer cessions and compare to the total ceded.
Pass when the layer cessions sum to the total ceded amount.

steps.title: Attach the calculation working to the referral
sop: Attach the full calculation working rather than the net figure alone.
Note the treaty structure version used in the calculation.
Save the attachment against the risk in the policy system.
Done when the working is attached to the risk.
verify: Open the attachment and confirm it shows the layer steps.
Pass when the attached working shows every layer applied.

steps.title: Refer net lines above the class retention limit
sop: Review risks where the net line exceeds the class retention limit.
Decide between facultative support, line reduction or declining.
Record the decision against the risk.
Done when every excess net line carries a decision.
verify: List bound risks and check net lines against class limits.
Pass when no bound risk exceeds the class net retention limit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks requiring a treaty capacity check before cession is assumed

generic.Test population: All cessions recorded against treaty sections in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a cession takes a treaty section beyond its available capacity
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfalls refer to the Senior Underwriter to place facultative or reduce the line
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Capacity check recorded on the risk with remaining capacity figure and date
generic.Evidence location: Capacity position report in Power BI attached to the risk in the workstation

steps.title: Open the treaty capacity position for the current treaty year

Select the section that would carry this cession.
Read the total capacity for the section.
Done when the section capacity position is on screen.
verify: Check the treaty year selected matches the policy inception year.
Pass when the report year covers the inception date.

steps.title: Deduct capacity already committed to bound and quoted business
sop: Read capacity committed to bound risks in the section.
Read capacity held against quoted-but-unbound risks.
Deduct both from total capacity to derive availability.
Done when the available capacity figure is derived.
verify: Recompute available capacity from the committed figures.
Pass when the derived availability matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Compare available capacity against the required cession
sop: Calculate the cession this risk would require from the section.
Compare it against the derived available capacity.
Record whether capacity is sufficient.
Done when the sufficiency result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the required cession from the risk limit and share.
Pass when the recorded cession matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Record any capacity shortfall for the facultative decision
sop: Where capacity is insufficient, quantify the shortfall amount.
Record the shortfall against the risk for the facultative decision.
Note the layer the shortfall sits in.
Done when the shortfall amount and layer are recorded.
verify: Recompute the shortfall as cession less available capacity.
Pass when the recorded shortfall matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Record the capacity check on the risk
sop: Record the check date and the remaining capacity figure on the risk.
Attach the capacity report extract used.
Save so the cession decision references the check.
Done when the capacity check is recorded on the risk.
verify: Reopen the risk and confirm date and figure are present.
Pass when every checked risk carries a dated capacity figure.

steps.title: Approve capacity use or route the shortfall
sop: Review risks consuming material section capacity or showing a shortfall.
Approve the capacity use or direct a facultative placement.
Record the decision against the risk.
Done when capacity decisions are recorded.
verify: Reconcile section cessions against section capacity for the period.
Pass when no section is ceded beyond its available capacity.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks awaiting release of binding authority pending reinsurance placement

generic.Evidence location: Placement confirmations on the risk in the policy administration system and GRC platform

steps.title: Confirm every layer is fully subscribed

Sum the subscriptions per layer and identify any unplaced balance.
Record the placement completeness position.
Done when each layer shows its subscription total.
verify: Sum subscriptions per layer against the required placement.
Pass when every layer totals one hundred percent.

steps.title: Obtain written confirmation from each participant
sop: Obtain the signed line slip, firm order acceptance or facultative acceptance.

Attach each confirmation to the risk record.
Done when every participant has a written confirmation on file.
verify: Compare confirmations held against participants recorded.
Pass when every participant has a matching written confirmation.

steps.title: Check each reinsurer against the approved security list
sop: Check each reinsurer against the approved security list in the GRC platform.
Confirm each is within its counterparty exposure limit after this cession.
Record any reinsurer failing either test.
Done when every participant has a security check result.
verify: Recheck a sample of participants against the security list.
Pass when every sampled participant is approved and within limit.

steps.title: Record the placement completion date and attach confirmations
sop: Record the date the placement reached full subscription.
Attach the confirmation set to the risk in the policy system.
Confirm the attachments are readable and indexed to the risk.
Done when completion date and confirmations are on the risk.
verify: Compare the completion date to the latest confirmation date.
Pass when the completion date is on or after the last confirmation.

steps.title: Release binding authority only after placement is confirmed
sop: Confirm the placement completeness and security checks have passed.
Release binding authority to the underwriter in the policy system.
Record the release with the date and the basis relied on.
Done when binding authority is released and recorded.
verify: Compare the authority release date to the placement completion date.
Pass when no release predates the placement completion.

steps.title: Rule on binding where placement is incomplete
sop: Review any request to bind with an unplaced percentage.
Decide to hold, reduce the line, retain net or decline.
Record the ruling and rationale on the risk.
Done when every incomplete placement carries a ruling.
verify: List bound risks and check for unplaced reinsurance percentages.
Pass when no bound risk carries an unplaced percentage.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cessions ready for handoff to reinsurance accounting for premium processing

generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete cession records return to the underwriter before accounting takes them up

steps.title: Confirm the cession record is complete before handoff

Correct any missing field before handoff.

verify: Run the cession completeness check on the record.

steps.title: Check cession dates against the direct policy period
sop: Read the direct policy inception and expiry dates.
Compare them to the cession inception and expiry dates.

Done when cession dates match the policy period.
verify: Compare the two date pairs on the record.
Pass when cession dates equal the direct policy dates.

steps.title: Pass the cession detail to reinsurance accounting
sop: Send the cession detail with the policy and treaty references.

Record the handoff date on the cession record.
Done when the cession detail has been handed off.
verify: Check the handoff log holds an entry for the cession.
Pass when every cession shows a logged handoff entry.

steps.title: Confirm the reporting period for the cession
sop: Determine the reporting period the cession must fall into.
State the period on the handoff so the bordereau picks it up.
Flag any cession at risk of missing its period.
Done when the reporting period is stated on the handoff.
verify: Compare the stated period to the cession effective date.
Pass when the stated period covers the cession effective date.

steps.title: Obtain acknowledgement from reinsurance accounting
sop: Chase reinsurance accounting for acknowledgement of each handoff.
Record the acknowledgement date on the cession record.
Escalate handoffs unacknowledged beyond the agreed window.
Done when every handoff carries an acknowledgement.
verify: List handoffs and check for acknowledgement entries.
Pass when no handoff is missing its acknowledgement.

steps.title: Resolve cessions rejected by accounting
sop: Review cessions returned by reinsurance accounting with queries.
Coordinate the correction with the owning underwriter.
Record the correction and the re-handoff date.
Done when every rejected cession is corrected and re-handed off.
verify: Check rejected cessions carry a correction and re-handoff entry.
Pass when no rejected cession remains unresolved.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks being tested for treaty automatic acceptance before facultative is considered

steps.title: Test the sum insured against the automatic acceptance limit
sop: Read the sum insured from the proposed policy terms.
Compare it against the treaty automatic acceptance limit for the class.
Record the tested value and the limit applied.
Done when the sum insured test result is recorded.
verify: Compare the tested sum insured to the proposed terms.
Pass when the tested value equals the proposed sum insured.

steps.title: Confirm occupancy, peril and territory sit inside treaty scope
sop: Read the treaty scope and exclusions for the class section.
Test occupancy, covered perils and location territory against the scope.
Record each test outcome individually.
Done when all three scope tests are recorded.
verify: Check all three scope dimensions carry a recorded outcome.
Pass when occupancy, peril and territory each have a result.

steps.title: Verify the policy period complies with treaty terms
sop: Read the proposed policy period and any multi-year structure.
Compare it against the treaty policy period conditions.
Record whether the structure complies.
Done when the policy period test is recorded.
verify: Check multi-year structures against the treaty period condition.
Pass when every multi-year structure carries a compliance result.

steps.title: Confirm no special acceptance condition removes automatic cover
sop: List the special acceptance conditions in the treaty section.
Test whether any applies to this risk and removes automatic cover.
Record the result against each condition.
Done when every special acceptance condition is tested.
verify: Check each listed condition carries a tested result.
Pass when no special acceptance condition is left untested.

steps.title: Record the eligibility outcome on the risk
sop: Record eligible or not eligible on the risk record.
Where not eligible, name the criterion that failed.
Save the record so the facultative decision reads it.
Done when the eligibility outcome and reason are recorded.
verify: Check ineligible risks name the failing criterion.
Pass when every ineligible outcome names a criterion.

steps.title: Review automatic acceptance calls near treaty boundaries
sop: Review risks marked eligible that sit close to a treaty limit or exclusion.
Re-test the boundary criteria on those risks.
Confirm or reverse the eligibility outcome.
Done when boundary cases carry a reviewed outcome.
verify: Sample automatically accepted risks and re-test against the treaty.
Pass when no sampled risk breaches a treaty exclusion or limit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks assessed for facultative need on line size or class restriction grounds
generic.In-scope period: Assessment made before terms are quoted to the broker

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Facultative amount required equals required line less treaty automatic capacity

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Timeline risks logged with the mitigation or the decision to quote conditionally
generic.Test population: All risks written in treaty-excluded classes or above automatic capacity
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a treaty-excluded risk is written without a facultative requirement recorded
generic.Exception handling path: Timeline or capacity concerns refer to the Senior Underwriter before terms are quoted
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Facultative requirement decision and amount recorded before terms are quoted

steps.title: Compare required line size against treaty automatic capacity
sop: Read the line size required to write the risk as intended.
Compare it against the treaty automatic capacity available.
Record the excess needing facultative support.
Done when the capacity excess is quantified.
verify: Recompute the excess as required line less automatic capacity.
Pass when the recorded excess matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Check whether the class or peril is treaty excluded
sop: Check the risk class and perils against the treaty exclusions.
Where excluded, record that facultative is needed regardless of size.
Note the exclusion clause relied on.
Done when the exclusion position is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded exclusion cites a treaty clause.
Pass when every exclusion finding cites a clause reference.

steps.title: Quantify the facultative amount required by layer
sop: Break the facultative requirement into layers to be placed.
Quantify the amount required in each layer.
Record the layer structure for the submission package.
Done when the requirement is quantified by layer.
verify: Sum the layer amounts against the total facultative requirement.
Pass when the layer amounts sum to the total requirement.

steps.title: Assess whether the timeline allows a facultative placement
sop: Compare the expected placement lead time to the broker deadline.
Record whether the placement can complete in time.
Note any mitigation such as quoting subject to reinsurance.
Done when the timeline assessment is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded lead time to the broker deadline.
Pass when timeline risk is flagged wherever the deadline is tight.

steps.title: Record the facultative requirement decision on the risk
sop: Record whether facultative is required and the amount needed.
Record the reason as capacity excess or class exclusion.
Save before quoting terms so the decision is on record.
Done when the decision is recorded ahead of quoting.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp to the quote timestamp.
Pass when the decision predates the quote.

steps.title: Confirm the facultative call with the Senior Underwriter
sop: Review facultative requirement decisions on excluded or large risks.
Confirm the amount and layer structure are correct.
Record confirmation or amend the requirement.
Done when the facultative call is confirmed.
verify: Sample treaty-excluded risks written in the period.
Pass when every sampled risk carries a facultative requirement record.

steps.title: Approach approved-security reinsurers or the placing broker

Send the facultative requirement with the submission package.
Record the approach date and the markets approached.

Record each negotiated position as it is agreed.

Calculate the resulting net premium and net position.
Compare the net position against the account target.
Done when the net position is calculated and compared.
verify: Recalculate the net position from the agreed rate and commission.
Pass when the recorded net position matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Check reinsurer conditions can be mirrored in the direct wording
sop: List each reinsurer-imposed warranty and exclusion.
Test whether each can be written into the direct policy wording.
Record any condition that cannot be mirrored.
Done when each condition has a concurrency result.
verify: Compare reinsurer conditions to the direct wording clauses.
Pass when every reinsurer condition appears in the direct wording.

steps.title: Confirm agreed terms in writing
sop: Obtain written confirmation of the agreed facultative terms.
Check the confirmation states rate, commission and conditions.
Attach the confirmation to the risk record.
Done when written confirmation is on file.
verify: Open the confirmation and check all three elements are present.
Pass when the written confirmation states rate, commission and conditions.

steps.title: Record the agreed terms against the risk
sop: Record the agreed rate, commission and conditions on the risk.
Link the written confirmation to the record.
Confirm the direct terms reflect the agreed reinsurance position.
Done when agreed terms are recorded against the risk.
verify: Compare the recorded terms to the direct policy terms.
Pass when the direct terms are consistent with the agreed reinsurance terms.

steps.title: Assemble the risk summary with values and location schedule

Attach the location schedule for all insured sites.
Confirm each element is taken from the direct submission record.
Done when the risk summary section is complete.
verify: Compare summary values against the direct submission record.

steps.title: Include loss experience with its valuation date

Confirm the figures agree to the loss runs on file.

sop: Attach the survey or engineering report held on the risk.
Attach the schedule of outstanding recommendations.

Done when survey and recommendations are included.

steps.title: State the requested facultative amount, layer and direct terms
sop: State the facultative amount and layer being sought.
State the proposed direct terms and rate for the risk.

sop: Trace each figure in the package back to the direct submission.

verify: Sample package figures and trace each to the submission record.

steps.title: Agree a decision date with the reinsurer

Pass when every stalled case shows an escalation.

steps.title: Confirm the cession record detail for the case

steps.title: Check the cession falls into the correct reporting period

Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Check certificate period, limit and share against the direct policy

steps.title: Attach the certificate or cession confirmation to the policy file
sop: Attach the certificate or cession confirmation to the policy file.

sop: Record the documentation check outcome on the risk.

Done when the check is recorded ahead of the bind.

Pass when the check predates the bind.

Record the ruling against the risk.

verify: List bound policies with ceded portions and check documentation.
Pass when no bound policy lacks cession documentation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All correspondence between the reinsurer and the internal underwriting team on a case

sop: Maintain the open question list for the case.

sop: Obtain the agreed terms in writing from the reinsurer.

sop: Record the concurrence date and the reinsurer reference on the case.

sop: Sample issued policies with reinsurer participation.
Compare the issued table rating to the concurred rating.
