List the indicators and attach the supporting evidence.
Record the escalation reference on the case.
Done when the escalation is raised with evidence.
verify: Open the escalation and check indicators and evidence are present.
Pass when the escalation names indicators and holds evidence.

steps.title: Place the case on hold pending the escalation
sop: Set the case to hold status in the policy administration system.
Confirm the hold prevents issue while the escalation is open.
Notify the producer that the case is held.
Done when the case is held from issue.
verify: Attempt an issue on a held case in a controlled test.
Pass when the system prevents the issue.

steps.title: Record the compliance outcome and resulting action
sop: Record the compliance outcome on the escalation.
Record the resulting action such as proceed, amend or decline.
Release or decline the case in line with the outcome.
Done when the outcome and action are recorded.
verify: Compare the case action to the recorded compliance outcome.
Pass when the action taken matches the compliance outcome.

steps.title: Review escalation quality and producer trends
sop: Review escalations raised in the period for indicator quality.
Identify producers with recurring escalations.
Record findings for distribution management follow-up.
Done when the escalation review is recorded.
verify: List issued cases and check for open escalations at issue.
Pass when no case was issued with an open escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: New applications screened for declared and undeclared replacement activity
generic.In-scope period: Screening at application receipt covering recent in-force surrender history
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Replacement question answer, notice presence, 1035 documentation and replacement flag
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases holding 1035 documentation equal cases carrying the replacement flag
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Source documents evidencing the determination retained on the case with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeclared replacements logged with the flag set and the producer query raised
generic.Test population: All applications screened for replacement activity in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a case holds 1035 documentation without the replacement flag set
generic.Exception handling path: Undeclared indicators route to the UW Operations Manager for flag enforcement
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Replacement flag set wherever 1035 or replacement notice documentation exists
generic.Evidence location: Replacement determination and source documents on the case in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Check the application replacement question and notice
sop: Read the replacement question answer on the application.
Check for a signed replacement notice in the case documents.
Record the declared replacement position.
Done when the declared position is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded position to the application answer.
Pass when the recorded position matches the application.

steps.title: Check for 1035 exchange or transfer paperwork
sop: Search the case documents for 1035 exchange paperwork.
Search for transfer requests indicating a replacement.
Record any document found even where undeclared.
Done when the 1035 and transfer check is recorded.
verify: Check the case document list against the recorded finding.
Pass when every 1035 document found is recorded.

steps.title: Cross-check internal in-force records for recent surrenders
sop: Search internal in-force records for the same life assured.
Look for a recent surrender or reduction in cover.
Record any internal replacement indicator found.
Done when the internal cross-check is recorded.
verify: Re-run the in-force search on the life assured.
Pass when the search covers all internal in-force policies.

steps.title: Set the replacement flag where any indicator is present
sop: Set the replacement flag on the case where any indicator exists.
Set the flag for undeclared indicators as well as declared ones.
Record which indicator drove the flag.
Done when the flag is set with a recorded indicator.
verify: Compare flagged cases to the indicators recorded.
Pass when every indicator-bearing case carries the flag.

steps.title: Retain the source documents evidencing the determination
sop: Attach the source documents that evidenced the determination.
Index them to the case in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Confirm they are retrievable for supervisory review.
Done when the source documents are retained on the case.
verify: Retrieve the documents from the case record.
Pass when every cited source document is retrievable.

steps.title: Reconcile 1035 documentation against replacement flags
sop: Extract cases holding 1035 documentation for the period.
Match each against the replacement flag status.
Return unflagged cases for correction.
Done when the reconciliation is complete.
verify: Count unflagged cases holding 1035 documentation.
Pass when no such case remains unflagged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Replacement cases requiring state notices to the applicant and existing insurer
generic.In-scope period: State-required number of days from the application date for insurer notification
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State of solicitation, notice version, delivery date, method and proof of sending
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices sent equal replacement-flagged cases requiring notification in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof of sending filed for applicant and existing insurer with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late notifications logged with the cause and the remediation recorded
generic.Test population: All replacement cases requiring state notices in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the existing-insurer notice date falls outside the state timeframe
generic.Exception handling path: Timeframe breaches escalate to the UW Operations Manager for compliance notification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: State notice and proof of sending filed for applicant and existing insurer
generic.Evidence location: Notice records and proof of sending on the policy record in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Identify the state of solicitation and the correct notice version
sop: Determine the state of solicitation from the application.
Select the current state replacement notice version for that state.
Record the state and notice version on the case.
Done when state and notice version are recorded.
verify: Check the notice version against the state requirement list.
Pass when the selected version is current for the state.

steps.title: Issue the notice to the applicant
sop: Issue the state replacement notice to the applicant.
Record the delivery date and the delivery method.
Attach proof of sending to the policy record.
Done when the applicant notice is issued and evidenced.
verify: Check proof of sending exists for the applicant notice.
Pass when every case holds applicant proof of sending.

steps.title: Notify the existing insurer inside the state timeframe
sop: Identify the existing insurer from the replacement documentation.
Send the required notification within the state-required days.
Record the notification date on the case.
Done when the existing insurer has been notified.
verify: Compare the notification date to the application date.
Pass when the gap is within the state-required number of days.

steps.title: Diary the response window and hold issue where required
sop: Diary the state response window from the notification date.
Hold issue until the window expires where the state requires it.
Record the hold and the expiry date on the case.
Done when the response window is diarised and enforced.
verify: Compare issue dates against the response window expiry.
Pass when no issue occurred before a required window expired.

steps.title: File proof of sending for both parties
sop: File proof of sending for the applicant and the existing insurer.
Index both to the policy record for examiner retrieval.
Confirm both documents open correctly.
Done when both proofs are filed and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve both proofs from the policy record.
Pass when both proofs of sending are retrievable.

steps.title: Review notification timeliness across the period
sop: Extract replacement cases and their notification dates.
Test each against the state-required timeframe.
Escalate breaches and record the remediation.
Done when the timeliness review is recorded.
verify: Count notifications outside the state timeframe.
Pass when no notification falls outside the required window.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suitability determinations requiring supervisory review before issue
generic.In-scope period: Review performed after the determination and before the case proceeds to issue
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Profile consistency check, basis test, cost comparison check and reviewer sign-off
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Supervisory reviews recorded equal suitability determinations made in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sign-off stored with reviewer name, date and the determination version reviewed
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disagreements logged with the required remediation and the outcome recorded
generic.Test population: All suitability determinations in the period requiring supervisory review
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a supervisory review is signed by the user who made the determination
generic.Exception handling path: Disagreed determinations return for remediation before the case can proceed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Supervisory review sign-off recorded with reviewer name and date before issue
generic.Evidence location: Supervisory review record on the case in the GRC platform

steps.title: Confirm the consumer profile supports the recommendation
sop: Read the consumer profile and the recommendation together.
Test whether the profile supports the product recommended.
Record any internal inconsistency in the profile.
Done when the profile consistency check is recorded.
verify: Check the review names the profile elements tested.
Pass when the review cites the profile elements it tested.

steps.title: Test the stated basis against the product features recommended
sop: Read the stated basis of recommendation.
Compare it to the features of the product actually recommended.
Record any feature that does not support the stated basis.
Done when the basis test is recorded.
verify: Check each stated basis element maps to a product feature.
Pass when every basis element maps to a recommended feature.

steps.title: Check the surrender charge and cost comparison figures
sop: Confirm the surrender charge and cost comparison were performed.
Trace the figures used back to their source documents.
Record any figure that cannot be sourced.
Done when the comparison figures are traced.
verify: Sample comparison figures and trace them to source.
Pass when every sampled figure ties to a source document.

steps.title: Record agreement or disagreement with the determination
sop: Record agreement or disagreement with the suitability determination.
Where disagreeing, state the remediation required.
Return the case where remediation is needed.
Done when the review conclusion is recorded.
verify: Check disagreements carry a stated remediation.
Pass when every disagreement names its remediation.

steps.title: Sign off the supervisory review before issue
sop: Sign off the supervisory review with name and date.
Confirm the sign-off precedes the case proceeding to issue.
Confirm the sign-off is under the reviewer own user.
Done when the review is signed off before issue.
verify: Compare the reviewer user to the determination user.
Pass when the two users are different.

steps.title: Audit supervisory review independence
sop: Sample supervisory reviews recorded in the period.
Test that the reviewer differs from the determining user.
Record the audit outcome and any breach found.
Done when the independence audit is recorded.
verify: Compare reviewer and determiner users across the sample.
Pass when no sampled review was self-signed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Replacement review documentation packs requiring retention for state examination
generic.In-scope period: Retention period required by the state of solicitation, taking the longest where several apply
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured, state, issue date and retention period applied
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed pack count agrees to the count of replacement cases issued in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Packs stored read-only with versioning applied to any subsequent change
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Packs missing supervisory sign-off logged with the completion action recorded
generic.Test population: All replacement packs filed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a replacement record is missing its supervisory sign-off document
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete packs return to the UW Operations Manager before audit sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete replacement pack filed with the state retention period applied
generic.Evidence location: Replacement pack in OpenText Document Mgmt indexed from the policy record

steps.title: Assemble the replacement pack as a single record
sop: Collect the replacement notices, comparison and suitability assessment.
Add the supervisory sign-off document to the pack.
File the pack as one record against the policy.
Done when the pack exists as a single filed record.
verify: Check the pack holds notices, comparison, assessment and sign-off.
Pass when all four components are present.

steps.title: Apply the state retention period
sop: Identify the state of solicitation and any other applicable states.
Apply the longest required retention period.
Record the retention period and disposition date on the pack.
Done when the retention period is applied.
verify: Compare the applied period to the state requirement table.
Pass when the longest applicable period was applied.

steps.title: Index the pack for examiner retrieval
sop: Index the pack by policy number, insured, state and issue date.
Confirm each value matches the policy administration system.
Test retrieval on each index value.
Done when the pack is retrievable on all four values.
verify: Search on each index value and confirm the pack returns.
Pass when all four searches return the pack.

steps.title: Confirm the stored pack is read-only and versioned
sop: Confirm the filed pack is stored read-only.
Confirm any change creates a new version rather than overwriting.
Record the configuration check.
Done when the immutability check is recorded.
verify: Attempt a controlled edit on a filed pack.
Pass when the edit creates a new version.

steps.title: Spot-check retrieval in examination request format
sop: Simulate a market conduct examination request.
Retrieve a sample of packs in that format.
Record any retrieval failure or missing component.
Done when the simulated retrieval is recorded.
verify: Check every sampled pack retrieved with all components.
Pass when no sampled retrieval failed.

steps.title: Audit packs for supervisory sign-off presence
sop: Sample filed replacement packs for the period.
Test each for the supervisory sign-off document.
Return incomplete packs and record the finding.
Done when the sign-off audit is recorded.
verify: Count sampled packs missing the sign-off document.
Pass when no sampled pack is missing its sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Replacement cases requiring a value and cost comparison of existing and proposed contracts
generic.In-scope period: Existing contract values as at the current valuation date on the case
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cash value, surrender charge, death benefit, guarantees, riders and proposed equivalents
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quantified replacement cost equals surrender charge plus acquisition cost less benefit gained
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Comparison stored on the case with the valuation date and source of each figure
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases where cost exceeds benefit logged with the stated justification recorded
generic.Test population: All replacement cases with a comparison performed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where cost exceeds benefit and no justification is recorded
generic.Exception handling path: Adverse comparisons escalate to the Senior Underwriter before approval
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Side-by-side comparison of existing and proposed contract values recorded
generic.Evidence location: Comparison document on the case in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Obtain current values on the existing contract
sop: Request current cash value and remaining surrender charge.
Record death benefit, guarantees and riders on the existing contract.
Note the valuation date of the figures.
Done when the existing contract values are recorded.
verify: Check each value carries a source and valuation date.
Pass when every existing value is sourced and dated.

steps.title: Set out the proposed contract equivalents side by side
sop: Record the proposed contract equivalents for each existing value.
Include any new surrender charge period on the proposed contract.
Present both sets side by side in the comparison.
Done when the side-by-side comparison is built.
verify: Check every existing value has a proposed counterpart.
Pass when no existing value is left without a comparison.

steps.title: Quantify the cost of replacing
sop: Quantify the surrender charge incurred on the existing contract.
Add the new acquisition cost and the value of lost guarantees or riders.
Record the total quantified cost of replacement.
Done when the replacement cost is quantified.
verify: Recompute the total cost from its components.
Pass when the recorded total matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Identify and test the benefit gained
sop: Identify the benefit the replacement delivers to the client.
Quantify the benefit where it can be measured.
Test whether the benefit justifies the quantified cost.
Done when the benefit test result is recorded.
verify: Compare the quantified benefit to the quantified cost.
Pass when the comparison outcome is explicitly stated.

steps.title: Write the suitability conclusion referencing the figures
sop: Write the suitability conclusion on the case.
Reference the comparison figures that support it.
Avoid conclusions that do not cite the comparison.
Done when the conclusion is written with figures cited.
verify: Check the conclusion cites specific comparison figures.
Pass when the conclusion references the comparison values.

steps.title: Review adverse comparisons before approval
sop: Review cases where quantified cost exceeds quantified benefit.
Require a written justification or decline the replacement.
Record the review outcome on the case.
Done when adverse comparisons carry a recorded outcome.
verify: List approved replacements with adverse comparisons.
Pass when each carries a stated justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Replacement cases requiring compliance sign-off on the suitability findings
generic.In-scope period: Sign-off obtained inside the case SLA and before the contract is issued
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Findings pack contents, routing date, sign-off outcome and any conditions recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packs routed to compliance equal packs with a recorded sign-off outcome
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing and sign-off entries stored on the case with dates and the pack version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue sign-offs logged with the chase issued and the escalation recorded
generic.Test population: All replacement cases routed for compliance sign-off in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a replacement case is issued without a recorded compliance sign-off
generic.Exception handling path: Finely balanced cases carry a stated question for compliance to rule on
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Findings pack routed to compliance with a recorded sign-off outcome
generic.Evidence location: Compliance sign-off record in the GRC platform linked to the case

steps.title: Assemble the suitability findings pack
sop: Collect the consumer profile, comparison and disposition.
Add the supervisory review to the pack.
Confirm the pack is complete before routing.
Done when the findings pack is assembled.
verify: Check the pack holds profile, comparison, disposition and review.
Pass when all four components are present.

steps.title: Route the pack to the compliance sign-off queue
sop: Route the pack through the workflow to the compliance queue.
Avoid routing by direct email outside the record.
Record the routing date on the case.
Done when the pack sits in the compliance queue.
verify: Check the compliance queue holds the routed pack.
Pass when the pack appears in the compliance queue.

steps.title: State the specific question where the case is finely balanced
sop: Where the case is finely balanced, state the question for compliance.
Reference the comparison finding creating the balance.
Record the question on the routing entry.
Done when finely balanced cases carry a stated question.
verify: Check balanced cases state a specific compliance question.
Pass when each such case names its question.

steps.title: Track the sign-off against the case SLA
sop: Monitor the sign-off against the case SLA.
Chase compliance where the sign-off is overdue.
Log each chase on the case record.
Done when overdue sign-offs carry logged chases.
verify: List overdue sign-offs and check for chases.
Pass when every overdue sign-off has a logged chase.

steps.title: Record the compliance sign-off decision and conditions
sop: Record the compliance sign-off outcome on the case.
Record any conditions attached to the sign-off.
Confirm the record precedes the issue date.
Done when the sign-off outcome is recorded before issue.
verify: Compare the sign-off date to the issue date.
Pass when the sign-off predates issue.

steps.title: Confirm no case is issued without sign-off
sop: Review replacement cases issued in the period.
Check each carries a recorded compliance sign-off.
Escalate any case issued without sign-off.
Done when the issue check is recorded.
verify: List issued replacement cases and check sign-off records.
Pass when no issued case lacks a compliance sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referred terms priced below technical price or carrying unpriced concessions
generic.In-scope period: Pricing position as at the referral date against the expiring policy year
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Technical price, proposed price, shortfall, rate change and concession list populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Stated shortfall equals technical price less proposed price in premium terms
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Challenge and response recorded on the referral with the pricing output version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overridden challenges logged with the documented decision to proceed
generic.Test population: All referrals approved below technical price in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where terms below technical price carry no recorded challenge and response
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved pricing disputes escalate through the Pricing Actuary for a technical view
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recorded challenge stating the technical versus proposed price shortfall
generic.Evidence location: Challenge record on the referral in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Quantify the shortfall against technical price
sop: Read technical price and proposed price from the pricing output.
Calculate the shortfall in percentage and premium terms.
Record both figures on the challenge entry.
Done when the shortfall is quantified and recorded.
verify: Recalculate the shortfall from the two prices.
Pass when the recorded shortfall matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Test rate change against expiring and portfolio movement
sop: Compare the proposed rate against the expiring rate in Guidewire PolicyCenter.
Compare the rate change against the class rate movement in the portfolio.
Record both comparisons on the challenge.
Done when both rate comparisons are recorded.
verify: Recompute the rate change from expiring and proposed rates.
Pass when the recorded change matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Challenge unpriced term concessions
sop: List each term concession such as deductible, sublimit or extension.
Identify concessions that are not reflected in the price.
Raise a challenge against each unpriced concession.
Done when every unpriced concession carries a challenge.
verify: Check each concession has a priced or challenged status.
Pass when no unpriced concession is left unchallenged.

steps.title: Obtain a technical view from the Pricing Actuary
sop: Review the rating basis and the adequacy of the proposed price.
State whether the shortfall is defensible on the exposure.
Record the technical view on the referral.
Done when the technical pricing view is recorded.
verify: Check the technical view names the parameters assessed.
Pass when the view cites the parameters it assessed.

steps.title: Record the underwriter response against each challenge point
sop: Record the underwriter response to each challenge raised.
Capture the supporting evidence offered with each response.
Mark each challenge as accepted, amended or contested.
Done when every challenge has a recorded response.
verify: Count responses against challenges raised.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm final terms reflect the challenge or a documented override
sop: Compare the final terms against the challenges raised.
Where terms are unchanged, record the decision to override.
Store the challenge record on the referral.
Done when final terms carry a challenge outcome or override.
verify: List terms approved below technical price in the period.
Pass when each carries a recorded challenge and response.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks exceeding the Chief Underwriting Officer authority ceiling on premium, limit or appetite
generic.In-scope period: Committee lead time window from submission to the scheduled decision date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Breached ceiling, risk summary, pricing, portfolio impact, recommendation and reference
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposure figures in the submission agree to the policy system risk record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee submission stored in SharePoint with the reference and submission date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Broker indications given ahead of committee logged and escalated for review
generic.Test population: All over-CUO-authority risks escalated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a quote is released on an over-authority risk before the committee decision
generic.Exception handling path: Urgent risks require a committee out-of-cycle decision rather than a pre-emptive quote
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Committee submission logged with the CUO recommendation and a reference number
generic.Evidence location: Committee submission in the GRC platform with the paper stored in SharePoint

steps.title: Confirm the risk exceeds the CUO authority ceiling
sop: Compare premium, limit and appetite position against the CUO ceiling.
State which dimension exceeds the ceiling and by how much.
Record the breach on the referral.
Done when the breaching dimension is recorded.
verify: Recompute the breach against the authority ceiling.
Pass when the recorded breach matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Prepare the committee submission
sop: Prepare the submission with risk summary, pricing and portfolio impact.
Include the CUO recommendation and its reasoning.
Use the standard governance submission template.
Done when the submission is prepared.
verify: Check the submission covers summary, pricing, impact and recommendation.
Pass when all four sections are present.

steps.title: Reconcile submission figures to the risk record
sop: Trace each exposure and pricing figure to the policy system record.
Correct any figure that does not tie back.
Record the reconciliation as complete.
Done when every submission figure ties to source.
verify: Sample submission figures and trace each to the risk record.
Pass when every sampled figure ties to the record.

steps.title: Submit to the underwriting committee with the required lead time
sop: Submit through the governance workflow in the GRC platform.
Meet the committee lead time for papers.
Record the submission date on the referral.
Done when the submission is lodged within the lead time.
verify: Compare the submission date to the committee lead time requirement.
Pass when the submission met the lead time.

steps.title: Confirm no indication has been given to the broker
sop: Check the submission record for any indication issued to the broker.
Confirm no commitment has been made pending committee decision.
Record the confirmation on the referral.
Done when the no-indication position is confirmed.
verify: Compare quote and indication dates to the committee decision date.
Pass when no quote predates the committee decision.

steps.title: Record the committee reference and scheduled decision date
sop: Record the committee reference number on the referral.
Record the scheduled decision date so the case can be tracked.
Notify the referring team of the timetable.
Done when reference and decision date are recorded.
verify: Check the referral carries a committee reference and date.
Pass when every escalation carries both values.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals reaching an authority sign-off decision with conditions attached
generic.In-scope period: Sign-off validity period from the decision date to the re-referral trigger
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authority level, exposure covered, conditions, validity period and signing user
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposure covered by the sign-off equals the full exposure on the risk
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sign-off stored with the signing user, authority level and decision timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Delegate sign-offs logged and reversed where the authority sits elsewhere
generic.Test population: All authority sign-offs recorded in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a sign-off is recorded under a user below the required authority level
generic.Exception handling path: Sign-offs above the holder authority escalate to the Chief Underwriting Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off recorded with authority level, conditions and a validity period
generic.Evidence location: Sign-off record in the GRC platform feeding the authority-usage audit extract

steps.title: Record the sign-off with the authority level relied on
sop: Open the referral in Guidewire PolicyCenter and record the sign-off.
State the authority level relied on for the decision.
Confirm the level covers the full exposure on the risk.
Done when the sign-off names its authority level.
verify: Compare the authority level to the exposure on the risk.
Pass when the level covers the full exposure.

steps.title: Enter each condition as a separate trackable line
sop: Enter each condition attached to the sign-off as its own line.
Name the clearance owner for each condition.
Avoid combining conditions into a single line.
Done when every condition exists as a trackable line.
verify: Count condition lines against the conditions in the decision.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: State the validity period and the re-referral trigger
sop: State the date after which the sign-off lapses.
State the term changes that would trigger a re-referral.
Record both on the sign-off record.
Done when validity and trigger are recorded.
verify: Check the validity date is later than the decision date.
Pass when every sign-off carries a forward validity date.

steps.title: Confirm the sign-off is recorded under the holder own user
sop: Confirm the sign-off is entered under the authority holder own login.
Avoid delegates recording the sign-off on the holder behalf.
Record the signing user on the sign-off entry.
Done when the signing user is the authority holder.
verify: Compare the signing user to the authority holder named.
Pass when the two are the same user.

steps.title: Verify the sign-off flows to the authority-usage extract
sop: Run the authority-usage extract from the GRC platform.
Confirm the sign-off appears with level, conditions and validity.
Correct any field that does not carry through.
Done when the sign-off appears complete in the extract.
verify: Check the extract row for blank authority or validity values.
Pass when the extract row is fully populated.

steps.title: Review sign-offs recorded at or above the CUO threshold
sop: Sample sign-offs recorded near the authority ceiling.
Test the signing user authority against the referral tier.
Ratify or reverse each sampled sign-off.
Done when sampled sign-offs carry a ratification decision.
verify: Compare signing user authority to referral tier across the sample.
Pass when no sampled sign-off was recorded below the required level.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referral packages requiring assessment against portfolio appetite and limits
generic.In-scope period: Appetite statement and limit framework current at the referral review date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: No-write screen result, limit tests, territory check and accumulation assessment
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requested limit tested equals the limit on the referred terms
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment recorded with the appetite version and the portfolio extract date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: No-write and prohibited-risk hits logged with the decline or exception outcome
generic.Test population: All referral packages assessed against appetite in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a referral is approved for an insured or class on the no-write list
generic.Exception handling path: No-write hits escalate to the Chief Underwriting Officer and cannot be approved locally
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Appetite and limit assessment recorded against the current appetite version
generic.Evidence location: Appetite assessment on the referral in the GRC platform with Power BI portfolio extract

steps.title: Screen the insured, parent and class against the no-write list
sop: Screen the insured and its parent against the no-write list.
Screen the industry class against the prohibited risk list.
Record the screening result on the referral.
Done when the no-write screen result is recorded.
verify: Re-run the screen on insured, parent and class.
Pass when all three were screened and results recorded.

steps.title: Test the requested limit against per-risk and aggregate limits
sop: Compare the requested limit against the class per-risk limit.
Compare the programme exposure against the aggregate limit.
Record both test results on the referral.
Done when both limit tests are recorded.
verify: Compare the tested limit to the limit on the referred terms.
Pass when the tested limit equals the referred limit.

steps.title: Check territory and jurisdiction against the licensed footprint
sop: List the territories and jurisdictions the risk exposes.
Check each against the licensed and appetite-permitted footprint.
Record any territory outside the permitted footprint.
Done when every territory has a checked result.
verify: Compare territories checked to the location schedule.
Pass when every exposed territory carries a check result.

steps.title: Assess the accumulation effect for the class and zone
sop: Pull the portfolio position for the class and zone from Power BI.
Assess the accumulation effect of writing the risk.
Record the post-risk position and the extract date.
Done when the accumulation effect is recorded.
verify: Recompute the post-risk position from the extract.
Pass when the recorded position matches the recomputation.

steps.title: Record the appetite and limit assessment before any decision
